sentences.zh: 求五星天正冬至後加時平合日度分秒：《乾元》謂之五星平合變日，《儀天》謂之常合中日中度。

translations.literal: To find the five planets' added-hour mean-conjunction day-degree-fraction-second after the winter solstice of heavenly first month: the Qianyuan calls it "five planets mean-conjunction variation day," the Yitian calls it "regular conjunction mid-day mid-degree."
translations.idiomatic: To determine each planet's mean-conjunction day, degree, parts, and seconds at the added hour after the winter solstice of the celestial first month: the Qianyuan calendar terms this the "five planets' mean-conjunction variation day," while the Yitian calendar calls it the "regular conjunction mid-day and mid-degree."

sentences.zh: 各以星總除元積為總數，不盡者，返減星總，餘，半而進位；

translations.literal: For each, divide the origin accumulation by the planet total to obtain the aggregate number; if there is a remainder, subtract it back from the planet total; with the remainder, round up at the half;
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, divide the origin accumulation by the planet's total to get an aggregate count; any remainder is subtracted back from the planet total, and halves are rounded upward;

sentences.zh: 又置總數，木、火三之，土如其數，皆百而從之，以元法收之，為天正冬至後平合日度及分。

translations.literal: Further set the aggregate number; triple for Wood and Fire, for Earth use its number as is, in each case carry at one hundred, collect by the origin divisor, to get the mean-conjunction day-degree and parts after the winter solstice of heavenly first month.
translations.idiomatic: Then take the aggregate number: triple it for Jupiter and Mars, leave Saturn's unchanged, carry at one hundred in each case, and reduce by the origin divisor to obtain the mean-conjunction day, degree, and parts after the winter solstice of the celestial first month.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》置歲積分，各以星率去之，不盡，用減星率，餘以五因之，滿元率收為日，不滿，退除為分。

translations.literal: Qianyuan: set the year accumulation parts; for each remove by the star rate; if not exhausted, subtract from the star rate; multiply the remainder by five; where it fills the origin rate collect as days, where not full retreat-divide as parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, set the year's accumulated parts; for each planet subtract the star rate; if a remainder remains, subtract it from the star rate; multiply the remainder by five; convert to days wherever the origin rate is filled, and retreat-divide the remainder into parts.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各以其星周率去歲積分，不滿者，返減其周率，余以宗法收為日，不盡，退除為分。

translations.literal: Yitian: each uses its planet circuit rate to remove from year accumulation parts; if not full, subtract back from its circuit rate; with the remainder collect as days by the clan divisor; what remains retreat-divide as parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, subtract each planet's circuit rate from the year's accumulated parts; if the result is insufficient, subtract back from the circuit rate; reduce the remainder to days by the clan divisor, and retreat-divide any leftover into parts.

sentences.zh: 求平合入曆分：《乾元》謂之入曆，《儀天》謂之推五星常合入曆度分。

translations.literal: To find mean-conjunction entering-epact parts: Qianyuan calls it "entering the epact," Yitian calls it "computing the five planets' regular conjunction entering-epact degree-parts."
translations.idiomatic: To find the parts for a mean conjunction's entry into the epact: the Qianyuan calendar calls this "entering the epact," while the Yitian calendar calls it "computing the five planets' regular-conjunction entering-epact degrees and parts."

sentences.zh: 各以其星變差展所求積年，滿三百六十五萬三千二百九十三、秒一十九，去之不盡，以元法收為度，不滿為分，以減平合日，為入曆度分。

translations.literal: For each, spread the sought accumulated years by that planet's variation difference; where it fills 3,653,293 and 19 seconds remove it; with the remainder not exhausted collect as degrees by the origin divisor, what does not fill becomes parts, subtract from the mean-conjunction day, to get entering-epact degree-parts.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, multiply the accumulated years sought by that planet's variation difference; remove multiples of 3,653,293 and 19 seconds; reduce the remainder to degrees by the origin divisor, treat the unfilled portion as parts, subtract from the mean-conjunction day, and thus obtain the entering-epact degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》以積年乘星差，以周天策去之，不盡，以元率收為度，不滿，退除為分，用減平合變日，為入曆分。

translations.literal: Qianyuan: multiply accumulated years by star difference, remove by the full-circuit tally; with the remainder not exhausted collect as degrees by the origin rate, where not full retreat-divide as parts, use to subtract from mean-conjunction variation day, to get entering-epact parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, multiply the accumulated years by the star's difference and subtract the full-circuit tally; reduce the remainder to degrees by the origin rate, retreat-divide any leftover into parts, subtract from the mean-conjunction variation day, and obtain the entering-epact parts.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其星歲差，以積年乘之，滿三百六十八萬九千八百八、秒九千九百去之，不盡，以宗法收為度，不滿，退收為分。

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets its planet's annual difference, multiplies by accumulated years, removes when full 3,689,808 and 9,900 seconds; with the remainder not exhausted collects as degrees by the clan divisor, where not full retreat-collects as parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each planet's annual difference, multiply by the accumulated years, and remove multiples of 3,689,808 and 9,900 seconds; reduce the remainder to degrees by the clan divisor, and retreat-collect any leftover into parts.

sentences.zh: 求入陰陽變分：在陽末變分以下為入陽曆；

translations.literal: To find entering yin-yang variation parts: if below the yang-terminal variation parts it is entering the yang epact;
translations.idiomatic: To find the entering yin-yang variation parts: if the value falls below the yang-terminal variation parts, the planet is entering the yang epact;

sentences.zh: 以上去之，餘為入陰曆。

translations.literal: If above, remove it, the remainder is entering the yin epact.
translations.idiomatic: If it lies above that threshold, subtract it away; the remainder is the entry into the yin epact.

sentences.zh: 置入陰、陽曆分，以陰、陽變數去之，不盡，為入陰、陽數及變分。

translations.literal: Set the entering yin/yang epact parts, remove by the yin/yang variation count; with the remainder not exhausted, that is the entering yin/yang number and variation parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entering yin or yang epact parts and subtract the yin or yang variation count; the remainder gives the entering yin or yang number and variation parts.
