translations.idiomatic: Further, Jupiter's front divisor is 1,708 and its rear divisor 1,334; Mars's front divisor is 1,641 and its rear divisor 1,403;

sentences.zh: 鎮星、辰星前後法皆一千五百二十二；

translations.literal: Saturn and Mercury front and rear divisors all 1,522;
translations.idiomatic: Saturn's and Mercury's front and rear divisors are each 1,522;

sentences.zh: 太白前法一千六百四十三，後法一千四百二。

translations.literal: Venus front divisor 1,643, rear divisor 1,402.
translations.idiomatic: Venus's front divisor is 1,643 and its rear divisor 1,402.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置常合入曆度分，如在上限末數已下者為增數；

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets the regular-conjunction entering-epact degree-parts; if at or below the upper-limit terminal number it is an increment number;
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each planet's regular-conjunction entering-epact degrees and parts; if the value is at or below the upper limit's terminal number, it counts as an increment;

sentences.zh: 以上者減去上限末數下度分，餘為入下限減數。

translations.literal: If above, subtract the degree-parts below the upper-limit terminal number, the remainder is the entering lower-limit decrement number.
translations.idiomatic: If it lies above, subtract the degrees and parts below the upper limit's terminal number; the remainder is the entering lower-limit decrement.

sentences.zh: 又各置所入上、下限度分，以上、下限度分相近者減之，餘為入次限、下限度及分。

translations.literal: Further for each set the entered upper/lower limit degree-parts, subtract the nearer upper/lower limit degree-parts, the remainder is the entered secondary-limit lower limit and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Then set the entered upper- or lower-limit degrees and parts for each planet, subtract whichever upper or lower limit degrees and parts are nearer, and the remainder is the entry into the secondary limit's lower limit and parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》五星辰星陰、陽差分並陰、陽差度並同初、末。

translations.literal: Qianyuan: for the five planets, Mercury's yin-yang difference parts and yin-yang difference degrees are both the same at initial and final.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, Mercury alone among the five planets has yin-yang difference parts and difference degrees that are identical at both the initial and final limits.

sentences.zh: 入陰陽定分：《乾元》謂之入諸曆變分，《儀天》謂之求五星常合入增減定數。

translations.literal: Entering yin-yang fixed parts: Qianyuan calls it "entering the various epacts' variation parts," Yitian calls it "finding the five planets' regular-conjunction entering increment-decrement fixed numbers."
translations.idiomatic: To find the entering yin-yang fixed parts: the Qianyuan calendar calls this "entering the variation parts of the various epacts," while the Yitian calendar calls it "finding the five planets' regular-conjunction entering increment-and-decrement fixed numbers."

sentences.zh: 以入變分各減初變分，餘卻以其變下損益率展之，百而一為分；

translations.literal: From each entering variation part subtract the initial variation part; with the remainder then spread by its variation's lower increase-decrease rate, one per hundred becomes parts;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the initial variation part from each entering variation part; spread the remainder by the lower increase-decrease rate of that variation, taking one part per hundred;

sentences.zh: 損益次變下陰、陽積為定分。

translations.literal: Increase or decrease the next variation's lower yin/yang accumulation to get fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Increase or decrease the yin or yang accumulation below the next variation to obtain the fixed parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》置平合入曆分，以其星入段前、後限分加減之，如不足，加周天以減之，餘卻依入曆分入初末限；

translations.literal: Qianyuan: set the mean-conjunction entering-epact parts, add or subtract that planet's entering-segment front/rear limit parts; if insufficient, add the full circuit to subtract; with the remainder then according to entering-epact parts enter initial/final limits;
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, set the mean-conjunction entering-epact parts and add or subtract that planet's front or rear segment limit parts; if the result is insufficient, add a full circuit before subtracting; with the remainder, enter the initial or final limit according to the entering-epact parts;

sentences.zh: 各置其段入曆分，前限以下為在前，以上者去之，為後限分；

translations.literal: For each set its segment entering-epact parts; if at or below the front limit it is in the front; if above, remove it, to get rear-limit parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the entering-epact parts for each segment: if at or below the front limit the planet is in the front segment; if above, subtract the front limit to obtain the rear-limit parts;

sentences.zh: 在中限以下為初限，以上去之，為末限分；

translations.literal: If at or below the middle limit it is the initial limit; if above remove it, to get final-limit parts;
translations.idiomatic: If at or below the middle limit it falls within the initial limit; if above, subtract the middle limit to obtain the final-limit parts;

sentences.zh: 置初、末，以前、後限星分除之為限數，不滿，為初末限日；

translations.literal: Set initial/final, divide by front/rear limit star parts to get limit number; what does not fill is initial/final limit days;
translations.idiomatic: Set the initial or final value and divide by the front or rear limit star parts to get the limit number; the remainder gives the initial or final limit days;

sentences.zh: 各以其限差分約之，為差；

translations.literal: For each reduce by its limit difference parts, to get the difference;
translations.idiomatic: Reduce each by its limit difference parts to obtain the difference;

sentences.zh: 初限以加、末限以減，用加減前、後限度為定度。

translations.literal: Initial limit add, final limit subtract, use to add-subtract front/rear limit degrees to get fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Add for the initial limit and subtract for the final limit, then apply this to the front or rear limit degrees to obtain the fixed degrees.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置常合所入限下度數及分，以其限下損益率乘之，退一等，以百約之為度，不滿為分，以損益其限下增、減積度及分。

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets the regular conjunction's entered limit-below degree number and parts, multiplies by its limit-below increase-decrease rate, retreat one rank, reduce by one hundred to get degrees, what does not fill becomes parts, to increase-decrease its limit-below increment-decrement accumulated degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set the degrees and parts below the limit into which the regular conjunction has entered, multiply by the increase-decrease rate below that limit, drop one place, reduce by one hundred to degrees and treat the remainder as parts, and thus increase or decrease the accumulated degrees and parts below the limit.

sentences.zh: 若求諸變增、減定度者，置其變入上下限，准此求之。

translations.literal: If seeking the various variations' increment-decrement fixed degrees, set their variation's entered upper/lower limits, seek accordingly by this.
translations.idiomatic: To find the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees for the various variations, set the upper or lower limits into which each variation has entered and apply this same procedure.

sentences.zh: 定合積日：《乾元》謂之求定日，《儀天》謂之求五星定合積日。

translations.literal: Fixed-conjunction accumulated days: Qianyuan calls it "finding the fixed day," Yitian calls it "finding the five planets' fixed-conjunction accumulated days."
translations.idiomatic: Fixed-conjunction accumulated days: the Qianyuan calendar calls this "finding the fixed day," while the Yitian calendar calls it "finding the five planets' fixed-conjunction accumulated days."

sentences.zh: 日除陰、陽定分，為二；

translations.literal: Divide the yin-yang fixed parts by day, yielding two;
translations.idiomatic: Divide the yin-yang fixed parts by the day unit to obtain two components;

sentences.zh: 陽加陰減平合日，為定積日及分。

translations.literal: Add yang and subtract yin from the mean-conjunction day, to get fixed accumulated days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add the yang portion and subtract the yin portion from the mean-conjunction day to obtain the fixed accumulated days and parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》置變日，以前、後限度前加後減，為定日。

translations.literal: Qianyuan: set the variation day, front limit add rear limit subtract, to get the fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, set the variation day, add for the front limit and subtract for the rear limit, and obtain the fixed day.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其星常合中日及餘，以入曆增減度增者增之、減者減之，金、水返而加減之，以日躔定差先減後加之，金、水則先加後減，即得定合積日及分。

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets its planet's regular-conjunction mid-day and remainder, where entering-epact increment-decrement degrees increase increase them decrease decrease them, for Metal and Water reverse the add-subtract, with the sun's march fixed difference first subtract then add, for Metal and Water first add then subtract, then obtain fixed-conjunction accumulated days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each planet's regular-conjunction mid-day and remainder; apply entering-epact increment-and-decrement degrees as increases or decreases; for Venus and Mercury reverse the addition and subtraction; apply the sun's-march fixed difference by subtracting first and then adding—for Venus and Mercury, add first and subtract afterward—and thus obtain the fixed-conjunction accumulated days and parts.

sentences.zh: 又《儀天》求入盈縮初末限，皆以半周天為准。

translations.literal: Further Yitian in finding entering excess-shortage initial/final limits, all take half the full circuit as standard.
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, when the Yitian calendar finds the entering excess-and-shortage initial and final limits, it always uses half the full circuit as the standard.

sentences.zh: 入氣盈縮度分：《乾元》謂之入氣，《儀天》謂之求入盈縮初末限。

translations.literal: Entering qi excess-shortage degree-parts: Qianyuan calls it "entering qi," Yitian calls it "finding entering excess-shortage initial/final limits."
translations.idiomatic: Entering-qi excess-and-shortage degrees and parts: the Qianyuan calendar calls this "entering the qi," while the Yitian calendar calls it "finding the entering excess-and-shortage initial and final limits."

sentences.zh: 置定積，以常數去之，不盡者，為入氣日分；

translations.literal: Set the fixed accumulation, remove by the constant number; with the remainder not exhausted, that is the entering-qi day-parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed accumulation and subtract the constant number; the remainder gives the entering-qi day-parts;

sentences.zh: 置入氣日分，如求朔望盈縮術入之，即得入氣盈縮度分。

translations.literal: Set the entering-qi day-parts, enter as in the method for finding new- and full-moon excess-shortage, then obtain entering-qi excess-shortage degree-parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entering-qi day-parts and apply the same procedure used to find new- and full-moon excess and shortage; the result is the entering-qi excess-and-shortage degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》置定日，以氣策去之為氣數，不盡，為入氣日；

translations.literal: Qianyuan: set the fixed day, remove by the qi tally to get the qi number; what is not exhausted is the entering-qi day;
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, set the fixed day and divide by the qi tally to obtain the qi number; the remainder gives the entering-qi day;

sentences.zh: 命以冬至，算外，即得入氣日及分。

translations.literal: Order from winter solstice, outside the count, then obtain entering-qi days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count outward from the winter solstice; the result gives the entering-qi days and parts.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置定合積日，在半周天以下者去之，餘為在縮，乃視在盈縮初限日及約餘以下者，便為在盈縮初限；

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets the fixed-conjunction accumulated days; if below half the full circuit remove it, remainder is in shortening; then see if at or below the excess-shortage initial-limit days and reduced remainder — if so it is in the excess-shortage initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set the fixed-conjunction accumulated days for each planet; subtract if below half the full circuit, and the remainder falls in shortening; if it is at or below the initial-limit days and reduced remainder of excess and shortage, it lies within the initial excess-and-shortage limit;

sentences.zh: 以上者，減去盈縮初限日約餘，為在盈縮末限日及餘。

translations.literal: If above, subtract the excess-shortage initial-limit days and reduced remainder, to get the excess-shortage final-limit days and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: If above that threshold, subtract the initial-limit days and reduced remainder of excess and shortage to obtain the final excess-and-shortage limit days and remainder.

sentences.zh: 定合日辰：《乾元》謂之日辰，《儀天》同《應天》。

translations.literal: Fixed-conjunction day and time: Qianyuan calls it day-and-time, Yitian same as Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed-conjunction day and time: the Qianyuan calendar calls this "day and time," while the Yitian calendar follows the Yingtian calendar.

sentences.zh: 以其大、小餘加入氣日，命從甲子，算外，即得所求。

translations.literal: Take its large and small remainders and add to the entering-qi day, order from jiazi, outside the count, then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Add the large and small remainders to the entering-qi day, count outward from jiazi, and obtain the desired result.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》、《儀天》以冬至大、小餘加定日，各滿紀法去之，餘並同《應天》。

translations.literal: Qianyuan and Yitian take winter-solstice large and small remainders added to the fixed day, each when full of era rule remove it, remainders all same as Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: In both Qianyuan and Yitian, add the winter solstice large and small remainders to the fixed day, subtract multiples of the era rule when full, and the remainders match those in the Yingtian calendar.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》冬至小餘以元率退收，百為母；

translations.literal: Qianyuan winter-solstice small remainder by origin rate retreat and collect, hundred as denominator;
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, convert the winter solstice small remainder by retreating and collecting with the origin rate, taking one hundred as the denominator;

sentences.zh: 又有日躔陰陽度，置其氣陰陽分，如求朔日度分術入之，即得所求。

translations.literal: Further there are sun's-march yin-yang degrees; set its qi's yin-yang parts, enter as in the method for finding new-moon day degree-parts, then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: There are also sun's-march yin-yang degrees: set the qi's yin-yang parts and apply the same procedure used to find the new-moon day degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求入月日數：《儀天》謂之求定合在何月日。

translations.literal: Finding entering-month day number: Yitian calls it finding on which month-day the fixed conjunction falls.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the entering-month day count: the Yitian calendar calls this "finding on which month and day the fixed conjunction falls."

sentences.zh: 置定合日辰大餘，以定朔大餘減之，餘命算外，即得所求。

translations.literal: Set fixed-conjunction day-and-time large remainder, subtract fixed-new-moon large remainder, order the remainder outside the count, then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Set the large remainder of the fixed-conjunction day and time, subtract the fixed-new-moon large remainder, and count outward from the remainder to obtain the desired result.

sentences.zh: 二曆法同。

translations.literal: The two calendars' methods are the same.
translations.idiomatic: The two calendars use the same method.

sentences.zh: 定合定星：《乾元》同。

translations.literal: Fixed-conjunction fixed star: Qianyuan the same.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed-conjunction fixed star: under Qianyuan, the method is the same.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》謂之求日躔先後定數、求五星定合定度及分。

translations.literal: Yitian calls it finding sun's-march front-rear fixed number, finding five planets' fixed-conjunction fixed degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: The Yitian calendar calls this "finding the sun's-march front-and-rear fixed number" and "finding the five planets' fixed-conjunction fixed degrees and parts."

sentences.zh: 各以其星入氣盈縮度分盈加縮減之，又以百除陰、陽定分，為度分；

translations.literal: Each by its planet's entering-qi excess-shortage degree-parts — excess add shortage subtract; also divide yin-yang fixed parts by hundred, to get degree-parts;
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, adjust by its entering-qi excess-and-shortage degrees and parts, adding for excess and subtracting for shortage; then divide the yin-yang fixed parts by one hundred to obtain degree-parts;

sentences.zh: 陽加陰減，皆加減平合，為定星；

translations.literal: Yang add yin subtract, all add-subtract mean-conjunction, to get fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: Add the yang portion and subtract the yin portion, apply these to the mean conjunction, and obtain the fixed star;

sentences.zh: 用加天正黃道日度，滿宿去之，不滿宿，即得所求。

translations.literal: Use to add to heaven's-first ecliptic day-degrees, when full of lodges remove, what does not fill a lodge, then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Add the result to the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree, subtract full lodges, and the remainder within a lodge gives the desired position.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》各置其星平合中星，以日躔陰陽度陰減陽加之；

translations.literal: Qianyuan: each sets its planet's mean-conjunction mid-star, by sun's-march yin-yang degrees yin subtract yang add;
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, set each planet's mean-conjunction central star and adjust by the sun's-march yin-yang degrees, subtracting yin and adding yang;

sentences.zh: 又以其星入曆限度前加後減之，即為其星定合定星。

translations.literal: Further by its planet's entering-epact limit degrees front add rear subtract, then that is its planet's fixed-conjunction fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Then add for the front limit and subtract for the rear limit according to the planet's entering-epact limit degrees; the result is that planet's fixed-conjunction fixed star.

sentences.zh: 余同《應天》。

translations.literal: The rest same as Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder follows the Yingtian calendar.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》置所入限日下小餘，以其日盈縮率乘，以宗法除為分，以盈縮其日下先後定分，為日躔先後定度及分；

translations.literal: Yitian: set entered-limit-day-below small remainder, multiply by that day's excess-shortage rate, divide by clan rule for parts, by excess-shortage adjust its day-below front-rear fixed parts, to get sun's-march front-rear fixed degrees and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set the small remainder below the entered limit day, multiply by that day's excess-and-shortage rate, divide by the fundamental rule to obtain parts, and adjust the front-and-rear fixed parts below that day by excess and shortage to obtain the sun's-march front-and-rear fixed degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 又各置其星常合中度及分，以入限增定度及分增減之。

translations.literal: Further each sets its planet's regular-conjunction mid-degrees and parts, by entered-limit increment fixed degrees and parts increase-decrease.
translations.idiomatic: Then set each planet's regular-conjunction mid-degrees and parts and adjust them by the increment fixed degrees and parts for the entered limit.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星增者減，減者增；

translations.literal: Metal and Water two planets — where increase, subtract; where decrease, add;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, reverse the adjustment: subtract where there is an increase and add where there is a decrease;

sentences.zh: 又以日躔先後定度及分，木、火、土即先減後加，金、水先加後減其日躔差，木星二因，退位，火星除二，土星退位，從下加三，金、水倍，用即得定度及分。

translations.literal: Further with sun's-march front-rear fixed degrees and parts: Wood Fire Earth then first subtract then add; Metal Water first add then subtract their sun's-march difference; Jupiter double factor retreat place, Mars divide by two, Saturn retreat place add three from below, Metal Water double, use then obtain fixed degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Then apply the sun's-march front-and-rear fixed degrees and parts: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn, subtract first and add afterward; for Venus and Mercury, add first and subtract afterward to the sun's-march difference—double Jupiter's value and drop one place; divide Mars by two; drop Saturn one place and add three from below; double Venus and Mercury—and thus obtain the fixed degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 余同《應天》。

translations.literal: The rest same as Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder follows the Yingtian calendar.

sentences.zh: 歲星入段亦名入變

translations.literal: Jupiter entering segment is also called entering variation.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter enters a segment, this is also called entering a variation.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入段鎮星入段太白入段辰星入段

translations.literal: Mars entering segment; Saturn entering segment; Venus entering segment; Mercury entering segment.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entering a segment; Saturn entering a segment; Venus entering a segment; Mercury entering a segment.

sentences.zh: 諸段平日平度：《乾元》謂之諸星變定積，《儀天》謂之五星諸變中日中度。

translations.literal: Various segments' mean days mean degrees: Qianyuan calls it various stars' variation fixed accumulation, Yitian calls it five planets' various variations mid-day mid-degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Mean days and mean degrees for the various segments: the Qianyuan calendar calls these the fixed accumulations of the planets' variations, while the Yitian calendar calls them the mid-days and mid-degrees of the five planets' various variations.

sentences.zh: 置平合日度，以諸段下平日平度加之，即得所求。

translations.literal: Set mean-conjunction day-degrees, add the various segments' below mean days mean degrees, then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean-conjunction day and degrees, add the mean days and mean degrees listed under each segment, and obtain the desired result.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》各置其星變日，以所求入曆前加後度前加後減之。

translations.literal: Qianyuan: each sets its planet's variation day, by the sought entering-epact front add rear subtract degrees front add rear subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, set each planet's variation day and adjust by the entering-epact, adding before the limit and subtracting after it, and adding before the degrees and subtracting after them.

sentences.zh: 其太白辰星夕見變及晨疾變，皆以返用加減。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury evening-visibility variations and morning-rapid variations, all reverse the add-subtract use.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury evening-visibility variations and morning-rapid variations, apply addition and subtraction in reverse order.

sentences.zh: 熒惑晨見變定，置定差，以進一位滿十一除之為定差，各依加減，即得所求；

translations.literal: Mars morning-visibility variation fixed: set fixed difference, advance one place and when full divide by eleven for fixed difference, each according to add-subtract, then obtain what is sought;
translations.idiomatic: For the Mars morning-visibility variation fixed value, set the fixed difference, advance one place, divide by eleven when full to obtain the fixed difference, and apply addition or subtraction accordingly;

sentences.zh: 在留變者，置其變定積，以前變前後度前後減之。

translations.literal: For those in stationary variation, set their variation fixed accumulation, by previous variation front-rear degrees front subtract rear subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For planets in a stationary variation, set their variation fixed accumulation and subtract according to the previous variation's front and rear degrees.

sentences.zh: 其火星三因之，後退者倍之。

translations.literal: For Mars triple the factor; for rear retrograde double it.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars, triple the value; for rear retrograde motion, double it.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其星常合中日中度及分，以其星諸變段下常加合中日變度加減中星，即得諸變中日中度及分。

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets its planet's regular-conjunction mid-day mid-degrees and parts, by its planet's various variation segments' below regular added conjunction mid-day variation degrees add-subtract mid-star, then obtain various variations' mid-day mid-degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each planet's regular-conjunction mid-day, mid-degrees, and parts; adjust them with the regular added conjunction mid-day variation degrees listed under each variation segment to obtain the mid-days, mid-degrees, and parts for all variations.

sentences.zh: 諸段入曆：《儀天》謂之求五星諸變入限及增減定度。

translations.literal: Various segments entering epact: Yitian calls it finding five planets' various variations entering limits and increment-decrement fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Segments entering the epact: the Yitian calendar calls this "finding the five planets' various variations' entering limits and increment-and-decrement fixed degrees."

sentences.zh: 置平合入陰陽曆分，各以逐段陰陽曆分加之，為諸段入曆分。

translations.literal: Set mean-conjunction entering yin-yang epact parts, each add the successive segments' yin-yang epact parts, to get various segments' entering-epact parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean-conjunction entering yin-yang epact parts, add the yin-yang epact parts of each successive segment, and obtain the entering-epact parts for the various segments.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》以在諸變曆分中入曆名曰限變度。

translations.literal: Qianyuan: entering epact within the various variation epact parts is named limit variation degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, entering the epact within the various variation epact parts is called the limit variation degrees.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其星常合入曆度分，以其星諸變段下上下限度分累加之，滿周天去之，余依常合術入之，各得增減定度。

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets its planet's regular-conjunction entering-epact degrees and parts, cumulatively adds its planet's various variation segments' below upper-lower limit degrees and parts, when full of full circuit remove, remainder according to regular-conjunction method enter, each obtains increment-decrement fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each planet's regular-conjunction entering-epact degrees and parts, cumulatively add the upper and lower limit degrees and parts listed under each variation segment, subtract full circuits when full, and with the remainder apply the regular-conjunction procedure to obtain the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees for each.

sentences.zh: 其金星在晨疾、晨合、夕見變者，置增減定度及分，以四乘三除，為金星變定差。

translations.literal: For Venus in morning-rapid, morning-conjunction, and evening-visibility variations, set increment-decrement fixed degrees and parts, multiply by four and divide by three, to get Venus variation fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus in its morning-rapid, morning-conjunction, and evening-visibility variations, set the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees and parts, multiply by four and divide by three, and obtain Venus's variation fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 其火星在晨見變者，以九乘，增減定度及分，退一位，為晨星變定差。

translations.literal: For Mars in morning-visibility variation, multiply by nine the increment-decrement fixed degrees and parts, retreat one place, to get morning-star variation fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars in its morning-visibility variation, multiply the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees and parts by nine, drop one place, and obtain the morning-star variation fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 諸段入變分：置入曆分，各以變分去之，餘為入變分。

translations.literal: Various segments entering variation parts: set entering-epact parts, each remove variation parts, remainder is entering-variation parts.
translations.idiomatic: Entering-variation parts for the various segments: set the entering-epact parts, subtract each variation part, and the remainder gives the entering-variation parts.

sentences.zh: 求陰陽定分，依平合術入之。

translations.literal: Find yin-yang fixed parts, enter according to mean-conjunction method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the yin-yang fixed parts, apply the mean-conjunction procedure.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》諸段變分在入變前述。

translations.literal: Qianyuan various segments' variation parts were stated before entering variation.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, the variation parts for the various segments were given above, before entering variation.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》即同《應天》。

translations.literal: Yitian then same as Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, the method is the same as in the Yingtian calendar.

sentences.zh: 五星諸段定積曰：《乾元》謂之求五星諸變定日。

translations.literal: Five planets' various segments' fixed accumulation days: Qianyuan calls it finding five planets' various variations' fixed days.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed accumulated days for the five planets' various segments: the Qianyuan calendar calls this "finding the fixed days of the five planets' various variations."

sentences.zh: 置其入陰陽定分，百除，為日分；

translations.literal: Set its entering yin-yang fixed parts, divide by hundred, to get day-parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set its entering yin-yang fixed parts, divide by one hundred to obtain day-parts;

sentences.zh: 陽減陰減諸段平日。

translations.literal: Yang subtract yin subtract from various segments' mean days.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the yang portion and the yin portion from the various segments' mean days.

sentences.zh: 其金水夕見、晨疾返為之定積。

translations.literal: For Metal and Water evening visibility and morning rapid, reverse to make their fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury evening-visibility and morning-rapid variations, reverse the procedure to obtain their fixed accumulation.

sentences.zh: 其金星晨次、晨遲，更用盈縮度縮加盈減定積為定。

translations.literal: For Venus morning secondary and morning slow, further use excess-shortage degrees — shortage add excess subtract — on fixed accumulation to make fixed.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus in its morning secondary and morning slow variations, further adjust the fixed accumulation with excess-and-shortage degrees, adding for shortage and subtracting for excess, to obtain the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 求其入氣月日，如平合術入之。

translations.literal: Find its entering-qi month-day, enter as in mean-conjunction method.
translations.idiomatic: To find its entering-qi month and day, apply the mean-conjunction procedure.

sentences.zh: 又熒惑前遲定積，置平合入陰陽曆分，加二萬一千六百七十五，盈三萬六千五百二十五半去之。

translations.literal: Further Mars front-slow fixed accumulation: set mean-conjunction entering yin-yang epact parts, add 21,675, when full remove 36,525 and a half.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars front-slow fixed accumulation, set the mean-conjunction entering yin-yang epact parts, add 21,675, and subtract 36,525 and a half when full.

sentences.zh: 餘與見求入陰陽曆同者，更不求之，如不同曆者，即依平合術入，所得，用加前遲留退、後退留平日為定積，入氣月日如前。

translations.literal: If remainder same as seen in finding entering yin-yang epact, do not seek again; if different epact, then according to mean-conjunction method enter, what is obtained use to add front-slow stationary-retreat and rear-retreat stationary mean days as fixed accumulation, entering-qi month-day as before.
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder matches the entering yin-yang epact already found, do not recalculate; if the epact differs, apply the mean-conjunction procedure, add the result to the front-slow stationary-retreat and rear-retreat stationary mean days to obtain the fixed accumulation, and find the entering-qi month and day as before.

sentences.zh: 又五星定用盈縮差及陰陽定分：歲熒惑鎮星晨見、夕疾、定合，太白定合、夕見、夕退、再合、晨見及後、晨疾，皆用盈縮定差，太白定合晨、夕見及後疾，皆用盈縮定差。

translations.literal: Further five planets fixed use excess-shortage difference and yin-yang fixed parts: Jupiter Mars Saturn morning visibility, evening rapid, fixed conjunction; Venus fixed conjunction, evening visibility, evening retrograde, second conjunction, morning visibility and after, morning rapid — all use excess-shortage fixed difference; Venus fixed conjunction morning, evening visibility and after rapid — all use excess-shortage fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, the five planets' fixed values use excess-and-shortage differences and yin-yang fixed parts: for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn at morning visibility, evening rapid motion, and fixed conjunction; and for Venus at fixed conjunction, evening visibility, evening retrograde, second conjunction, morning visibility and afterward, and morning rapid motion—all use the excess-and-shortage fixed difference; for Venus at fixed conjunction in the morning, evening visibility, and afterward rapid motion, all likewise use the excess-and-shortage fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 內歲星後疾不用盈縮定差，辰星諸段總用盈縮定差盈加縮減。

translations.literal: Within this Jupiter later rapid does not use excess-shortage fixed difference; Mercury various segments altogether use excess-shortage fixed difference — excess add shortage subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter's later rapid motion does not use the excess-and-shortage fixed difference; Mercury's various segments always use the excess-and-shortage fixed difference, adding for excess and subtracting for shortage.

sentences.zh: 熒惑晨見陰陽定分身外加一，前疾陽定分再析，各為定分。

translations.literal: Mars morning visibility yin-yang fixed parts add one outside the body; front rapid yang fixed parts again divide, each becomes fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars morning visibility, add one to the yin-yang fixed parts outside the body; for front rapid motion, divide the yang fixed parts again, and each portion becomes a fixed part.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》諸變定日在入變前。

translations.literal: Qianyuan various variations' fixed days are before entering variation.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, the fixed days for the various variations are given before entering variation.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其星入變中日，以其星所入變限增減定度及分，增者增之，減者減之。

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets its planet's entering-variation mid-day, by its planet's entered variation limit increment-decrement fixed degrees and parts — where increase increase, where decrease decrease.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each planet's entering-variation mid-day and adjust by the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees and parts for the entered variation limit, adding increases and subtracting decreases.

sentences.zh: 其金星定合、夕見、夕順疾、夕次疾、晨次疾，水星定合、夕見、晨疾變，皆以增減定度及分，增者減之，減者增之，各得定日。

translations.literal: For Venus fixed conjunction, evening visibility, evening direct rapid, evening secondary rapid, morning secondary rapid; Mercury fixed conjunction, evening visibility, morning rapid variation — all by increment-decrement fixed degrees and parts, where increase subtract, where decrease add, each obtains fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at fixed conjunction, evening visibility, evening direct rapid motion, evening secondary rapid motion, and morning secondary rapid motion; and for Mercury at fixed conjunction, evening visibility, and morning rapid variation—apply the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees and parts, subtracting increases and adding decreases, to obtain each fixed day.

sentences.zh: 合用日躔差者，乃以日躔先後定差先減後加，乃為定日及分。

translations.literal: Where sun's-march difference is used together, then by sun's-march front-rear fixed difference first subtract then add, then is fixed day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Where the sun's-march difference is also required, apply the sun's-march front-and-rear fixed difference by subtracting first and adding afterward to obtain the fixed day and parts.

sentences.zh: 其日躔差，金水定合、夕見、晨疾，以日躔差先加後減，乃為定日及分天之度數。

translations.literal: Its sun's-march difference: Metal Water fixed conjunction, evening visibility, morning rapid — by sun's-march difference first add then subtract, then is fixed day and parts and heaven's degrees.
translations.idiomatic: For the sun's-march difference at Venus and Mercury fixed conjunction, evening visibility, and morning rapid motion, apply the sun's-march difference by adding first and subtracting afterward to obtain the fixed day, parts, and celestial degrees.

sentences.zh: 定星：《乾元》謂之求五星諸變定星，《儀天》謂之求五星諸變定度。

translations.literal: Fixed star: Qianyuan calls it finding five planets' various variations' fixed star, Yitian calls it finding five planets' various variations' fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed star: the Qianyuan calendar calls this "finding the five planets' various variations' fixed stars," while the Yitian calendar calls it "finding the five planets' various variations' fixed degrees."

sentences.zh: 以合用盈縮定差加減平度分，又以陰陽定分陽加陰減。

translations.literal: Use together the excess-shortage fixed difference to add-subtract mean degrees and parts, further by yin-yang fixed parts yang add yin subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust the mean degrees and parts with the applicable excess-and-shortage fixed difference, then add the yang portion and subtract the yin portion of the yin-yang fixed parts.

sentences.zh: 其金水夕見、晨疾返用為定星，求宿度，加平合入之。

translations.literal: For Metal Water evening visibility and morning rapid reverse use as fixed star; find lodge degrees, add mean-conjunction and enter.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury evening-visibility and morning-rapid variations, reverse the procedure to obtain the fixed star; then find the lodge degrees by adding to the mean conjunction.

sentences.zh: 熒惑前遲、後退差度以二百三十六度加前遲定星，二百五十七度加後退定星，如半周天以下為陽度；

translations.literal: Mars front-slow and rear-retreat difference degrees: add 236 degrees to front-slow fixed star, 257 degrees to rear-retreat fixed star; if at or below half the full circuit it is yang degrees;
translations.idiomatic: For Mars front-slow and rear-retreat difference degrees, add 236 degrees to the front-slow fixed star and 257 degrees to the rear-retreat fixed star; if at or below half the full circuit the result is yang degrees;

sentences.zh: 以上者去之，余為陰度；

translations.literal: If above remove it, remainder is yin degrees;
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract half the full circuit; the remainder gives yin degrees;

sentences.zh: 前遲陰陽度在一百一十度以上者，返減半周天，餘以五因之，後退入陰陽度在七十四度以下者，亦五因之，皆滿百為度分，陽減陰加定星，為前遲、後退定星；

translations.literal: Front-slow yin-yang degrees above 110 degrees reverse subtract half full circuit, remainder multiply by five; rear-retreat entering yin-yang degrees at or below 74 degrees also multiply by five; all when full hundred become degree-parts, yang subtract yin add fixed star, to get front-slow and rear-retreat fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: If front-slow yin-yang degrees exceed 110 degrees, subtract half the full circuit in reverse and multiply the remainder by five; if rear-retreat entering yin-yang degrees are at or below 74 degrees, likewise multiply by five; reduce by one hundred to degrees and parts, subtract yang and add yin to the fixed star, and obtain the front-slow and rear-retreat fixed star;

sentences.zh: 求宿度，加平合入之。

translations.literal: Find lodge degrees, add mean-conjunction and enter.
translations.idiomatic: Find the lodge degrees by adding to the mean conjunction.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》置其星其變中星，以入曆前後度前加後減之，又合用陰陽度者，陰減陽加之，為定星；

translations.literal: Qianyuan: set its planet's variation mid-star, by entering-epact front-rear degrees front add rear subtract; further where yin-yang degrees are used together, yin subtract yang add, as fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, set the planet's variation mid-star and adjust by the entering-epact front and rear degrees, adding before and subtracting after; where yin-yang degrees also apply, subtract yin and add yang to obtain the fixed star;

sentences.zh: 以冬至黃道日度加之，命從鬥宿，算外，即其變所入宿次也。

translations.literal: Add winter-solstice ecliptic day-degrees, order from Dipper lodge, outside the count, then that is the variation's entered lodge sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Add the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree, count outward from the Dipper lodge, and obtain the lodge sequence entered by that variation.

sentences.zh: 若在留變者，更不求定星也，只用前變定星為留變定星。

translations.literal: If in stationary variation, do not further seek fixed star; only use previous variation's fixed star as stationary variation fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: If the planet is in a stationary variation, do not seek a separate fixed star; use only the previous variation's fixed star as the stationary variation fixed star.

sentences.zh: 又熒惑留差，以一百一十九度減前遲定星，以一百三十四度減後退定星，在一百八十二度半以下為前，以上者去之為後，置前後度，在七十三度以下為在前，以上者返減一百八十三度半，餘為後度，皆倍之，百除為度，命曰留差度及分也。

translations.literal: Further Mars stationary difference: subtract 119 degrees from front-slow fixed star, subtract 134 degrees from rear-retreat fixed star; at or below 182 degrees and a half is front, if above remove to get rear; set front-rear degrees, at or below 73 degrees is in front, if above reverse subtract 183 degrees and a half, remainder is rear degrees; all double, divide by hundred for degrees, named stationary-difference degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars stationary difference, subtract 119 degrees from the front-slow fixed star and 134 degrees from the rear-retreat fixed star; if at or below 182 degrees and a half the value is front, otherwise subtract to obtain rear; set the front and rear degrees—if at or below 73 degrees it is front, otherwise reverse-subtract 183 degrees and a half for the rear degrees; double each, divide by one hundred for degrees, and name the result the stationary-difference degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 又前退定星度，以一百二十三度減前退定星，又以一百三十一度減後退定星，在一百八十二度半以下者為前，以上者去之為後，視前後度在七十三度以下為前，以上者返減一百八十二度半為後：皆以倍之，百除為度，即得前後退差度及分也；

translations.literal: Further front-retreat fixed-star degrees: subtract 123 degrees from front-retreat fixed star, subtract 131 degrees from rear-retreat fixed star; at or below 182 degrees and a half is front, if above remove to get rear; see front-rear degrees at or below 73 degrees as front, if above reverse subtract 182 degrees and a half as rear: all double, divide by hundred for degrees, then obtain front-rear retreat difference degrees and parts;
translations.idiomatic: For front-retreat fixed-star degrees, subtract 123 degrees from the front-retreat fixed star and 131 degrees from the rear-retreat fixed star; if at or below 182 degrees and a half the value is front, otherwise subtract to obtain rear; if the front and rear degrees are at or below 73 degrees treat them as front, otherwise reverse-subtract 182 degrees and a half for rear; double each, divide by one hundred for degrees, and obtain the front and rear retreat difference degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 用前減後加其段定星為定星。

translations.literal: Use front subtract rear add to its segment fixed star as fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply front subtraction and rear addition to the segment fixed star to obtain the fixed star.

sentences.zh: 又五星用陰陽度：歲星熒惑鎮星晨見，後疾，夕合；

translations.literal: Further five planets use yin-yang degrees: Jupiter Mars Saturn morning visibility, later rapid, evening conjunction;
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, the five planets use yin-yang degrees at the following points: Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn at morning visibility, later rapid motion, and evening conjunction;

sentences.zh: 太白夕見、退，夕合，晨見，後疾，平合皆用日躔、陰陽度，其辰星諸段皆用之。

translations.literal: Venus evening visibility and retrograde, evening conjunction, morning visibility, later rapid, mean conjunction all use sun's-march and yin-yang degrees; Mercury various segments all use them.
translations.idiomatic: Venus at evening visibility and retrograde, evening conjunction, morning visibility, later rapid motion, and mean conjunction all use sun's-march and yin-yang degrees; Mercury uses them at all segments.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其星其變中度及分，以其變入限增減定度及分，增者增之，減者減之。

translations.literal: Yitian: each sets its planet's variation mid-degrees and parts, by its variation entered limit increment-decrement fixed degrees and parts — where increase increase, where decrease decrease.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each planet's variation mid-degrees and parts and adjust by the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees and parts for the entered variation limit, adding increases and subtracting decreases.

sentences.zh: 其金星定合、夕見、夕定度及分，增者減之，減者增之，各得定日、次定日，各加減訖後，合用日躔先後定差者，以日躔先後定差及分先減後加之，即各得定度及分。

translations.literal: For Venus fixed conjunction, evening visibility, evening fixed degrees and parts — where increase subtract, where decrease add, each obtains fixed day and secondary fixed day; after each add-subtract finished, where sun's-march front-rear fixed difference is used together, by sun's-march front-rear fixed difference and parts first subtract then add, then each obtains fixed degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus at fixed conjunction and evening visibility, reverse the evening fixed degrees and parts—subtract increases and add decreases—to obtain the fixed day and secondary fixed day; after all adjustments, where the sun's-march front-and-rear fixed difference applies, subtract first and add afterward with its degrees and parts to obtain the fixed degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 其日躔差，木星定合，五因，半而退位，晨見先二因，退位，後五因，半而退位；

translations.literal: Its sun's-march difference: Jupiter fixed conjunction, five factor, half and retreat place; morning visibility first double factor retreat place, afterward five factor half and retreat place;
translations.idiomatic: For the sun's-march difference: at Jupiter fixed conjunction, multiply by five, halve, and drop one place; at morning visibility, first double and drop one place, afterward multiply by five, halve, and drop one place;

sentences.zh: 後定疾先差五因，半而退位，定差二因退位；

translations.literal: Afterward fixed rapid first difference five factor half and retreat place, fixed difference double factor retreat place;
translations.idiomatic: For afterward fixed rapid motion, apply five to the first difference, halve, and drop one place; for the fixed difference, double and drop one place;

sentences.zh: 火星定合，身外除二，晨見先差七因，退位，後差身外除二，後差七因退位；

translations.literal: Mars fixed conjunction, outside the body divide by two; morning visibility first difference seven factor retreat place, afterward difference outside body divide by two, afterward difference seven factor retreat place;
translations.idiomatic: For Mars fixed conjunction, divide by two outside the body; at morning visibility, multiply the first difference by seven and drop one place; for the afterward difference, divide by two outside the body, then multiply by seven and drop one place;

sentences.zh: 土星定合，退位從下加二，晨見先差退位，後差從下加三，退位，後差退位；

translations.literal: Saturn fixed conjunction, retreat place add two from below; morning visibility first difference retreat place, afterward difference add three from below retreat place, afterward difference retreat place;
translations.idiomatic: For Saturn fixed conjunction, drop one place and add two from below; at morning visibility, drop the first difference one place; for the afterward difference, add three from below, drop one place, and drop the afterward difference one place;

sentences.zh: 金星定合，二因之，夕見先差伏倍用，後差從下加三，晨疾伏先差從下加二，後差二因，夕退伏、晨退見六因，先後退位；

translations.literal: Venus fixed conjunction, double factor; evening visibility first difference occultation double use, afterward difference add three from below; morning rapid occultation first difference add two from below, afterward difference double factor; evening retrograde occultation and morning retrograde visibility six factor, front and rear retreat place;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus fixed conjunction, double the factor; at evening visibility, double the first difference at occultation; for the afterward difference, add three from below; at morning rapid occultation, add two from below to the first difference and double the afterward difference; at evening retrograde occultation and morning retrograde visibility, multiply by six and drop one place front and rear;

sentences.zh: 水星夕見後差從下加三，先差二因，晨疾先差從下加三，後差倍用，定合乃用加減次定度為定度，置定度及分，以加天正冬至加時黃道日度及分，命從鬥宿初度起算，至不滿宿，算外，即得其變加時宿度，其火星前、後退及前遲變皆為次定星，又置之，以留退定差度及分，增者增之，減者減之，得為前、後退定度，前遲，置前留定差，以三 除之，乃用增減前遲定度也。

translations.literal: Mercury evening visibility afterward difference add three from below, first difference double factor; morning rapid first difference add three from below, afterward difference double use; fixed conjunction then use add-subtract secondary fixed degrees as fixed degrees, set fixed degrees and parts, add heaven's-first winter-solstice added-time ecliptic day-degrees and parts, order from Dipper lodge initial degree count, until not filling a lodge outside count, then obtain its variation added-time lodge degrees; Mars front-rear retreat and front-slow variations all are secondary fixed star, set again, by stationary-retreat fixed difference degrees and parts — where increase increase, where decrease decrease — get as front-rear retreat fixed degrees; front-slow, set front stationary fixed difference, divide by three, then use to increase-decrease front-slow fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury evening visibility, add three from below to the afterward difference and double the first difference; at morning rapid motion, add three from below to the first difference and double the afterward difference; at fixed conjunction, apply addition and subtraction to the secondary fixed degrees to obtain the fixed degrees; set the fixed degrees and parts, add the winter solstice added-time ecliptic solar degrees and parts, count from the Dipper lodge initial degree until the remainder falls within a lodge, and obtain the variation's added-time lodge degrees; Mars front and rear retreat and front-slow variations all yield secondary fixed stars—set them again, adjust by the stationary-retreat fixed difference degrees and parts, adding increases and subtracting decreases, to obtain front and rear retreat fixed degrees; for front-slow motion, set the front stationary fixed difference, divide by three, and use it to adjust the front-slow fixed degrees.

sentences.zh: 又火星留差，以一百二十四半減前遲次定度，又以二百四十六度少加後退定度，若在一百八十二度六十二分以下為入在增；

translations.literal: Further Mars stationary difference: subtract 124 and a half from front-slow secondary fixed degrees, add 246 degrees and a little less to rear-retreat fixed degrees; if at or below 182 degrees 62 parts is entering in increase;
translations.idiomatic: For Mars stationary difference, subtract 124 and a half from the front-slow secondary fixed degrees and add 246 degrees and a little less to the rear-retreat fixed degrees; if at or below 182 degrees 62 parts the value is entering in increase;

sentences.zh: 以上者，以減去一百八十二度六十二分為入在減。

translations.literal: If above, subtract 182 degrees 62 parts to get entering in decrease.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract 182 degrees 62 parts to obtain entering in decrease.

sentences.zh: 置入在增、減度及分，如在七十二度以下者為上限；

translations.literal: Set entering in increase-decrease degrees and parts; if at or below 72 degrees it is upper limit;
translations.idiomatic: Set the entering increase-and-decrease degrees and parts; if at or below 72 degrees it is the upper limit;

sentences.zh: 以上者，返減一百八十二度六十二分，餘為下限。

translations.literal: If above, reverse subtract 182 degrees 62 parts, remainder is lower limit.
translations.idiomatic: If above, reverse-subtract 182 degrees 62 parts; the remainder is the lower limit.

sentences.zh: 各置所入上、下限增減度及分，在上限四因之，在下限倍，身外加三，皆以一百約之為度及分，若在後留者，三因之為定差度及分。

translations.literal: Each set entered upper-lower limit increment-decrement degrees and parts; at upper limit four factor, at lower limit double, outside body add three, all reduce by hundred for degrees and parts; if in rear stationary, triple for fixed-difference degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Set the increment-and-decrement degrees and parts for the entered upper or lower limit; at the upper limit multiply by four, at the lower limit double, add three outside the body, and reduce by one hundred to degrees and parts; if in rear stationary motion, triple to obtain the fixed-difference degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 又，《儀天》有火星退定差度及分，以二百四十一度少加前退後次定度，又以一百一十九度減退次定度及分，餘，在一百八十二度六十二分以下者為入在增；

translations.literal: Further, Yitian has Mars retreat fixed-difference degrees and parts: add 241 degrees and a little less to front-retreat rear secondary fixed degrees, subtract 119 degrees from retreat secondary fixed degrees and parts; remainder at or below 182 degrees 62 parts is entering in increase;
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, the Yitian calendar has Mars retreat fixed-difference degrees and parts: add 241 degrees and a little less to the front-retreat rear secondary fixed degrees and subtract 119 degrees from the retreat secondary fixed degrees and parts; if the remainder is at or below 182 degrees 62 parts it is entering in increase;

sentences.zh: 以上者，減去一百八十二度六十二分，餘為入在減。

translations.literal: If above, subtract 182 degrees 62 parts, remainder is entering in decrease.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract 182 degrees 62 parts; the remainder is entering in decrease.

sentences.zh: 又置入上、下限度分，若在七十二度以下者為上限，如在七十二度以上者為減一百八十二度六十二分，餘為下限。

translations.literal: Further set entered upper-lower limit degrees and parts; if at or below 72 degrees it is upper limit, if above 72 degrees subtract 182 degrees 62 parts, remainder is lower limit.
translations.idiomatic: Set the entered upper and lower limit degrees and parts; if at or below 72 degrees it is the upper limit; if above 72 degrees, subtract 182 degrees 62 parts and treat the remainder as the lower limit.

sentences.zh: 又置上下限增減度分，在上為度，不滿為分，即各得退定差度及分，其定差，如在後退者，倍之為定差。

translations.literal: Further set upper-lower limit increment-decrement degrees and parts; above as degrees, not full as parts, then each obtains retreat fixed-difference degrees and parts; its fixed difference, if in rear retreat double as fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the upper and lower limit increment-and-decrement degrees and parts; take the whole as degrees and the remainder as parts to obtain the retreat fixed-difference degrees and parts; if the fixed difference is in rear retreat, double it.

sentences.zh: 又有火星留定日，各置前、後留常中日，前留以前遲變入限增減定度及分，增者增之，減者減之，各以前、後留定差度及分，增者加之，減者損之，即得前、後留定日，其增減差通入曆用之。

translations.literal: Further there is Mars stationary fixed day: each set front-rear stationary regular mid-days, front stationary by front-slow variation entered limit increment-decrement fixed degrees and parts — where increase increase, where decrease decrease — each by front-rear stationary difference degrees and parts — where increase add, where decrease reduce — then obtain front-rear stationary fixed days; its increment-decrement difference is used together through entering epact.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Mars stationary fixed day: set the front and rear stationary regular mid-days; for front stationary, adjust by the front-slow variation entered limit increment-and-decrement fixed degrees and parts, adding increases and subtracting decreases; then apply the front and rear stationary difference degrees and parts, adding increases and reducing decreases, to obtain the front and rear stationary fixed days; the increment-and-decrement difference is applied together through entering the epact.

sentences.zh: 又有火星前、後退定度，各置前、後變次定度及分，以前、後退定差度及分，如在增者加之，在減者損之，即得定度及分；

translations.literal: Further there is Mars front-rear retreat fixed degrees: each set front-rear variation secondary fixed degrees and parts, by front-rear retreat fixed-difference degrees and parts — if in increase add, if in decrease reduce — then obtain fixed degrees and parts;
translations.idiomatic: There are also Mars front and rear retreat fixed degrees: set the front and rear variation secondary fixed degrees and parts and, by the front and rear retreat fixed-difference degrees and parts, add if in increase and reduce if in decrease to obtain the fixed degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 置定度及分，以加天正冬至黃道日度及分，命從鬥宿初度去之，至不滿宿，算外，即得退行所在宿度及分也，其增減定度，三除乃用之。

translations.literal: Set fixed degrees and parts, add heaven's-first winter-solstice ecliptic day-degrees and parts, order from Dipper lodge initial degree remove, until not filling a lodge outside count, then obtain retrograde motion's lodge degrees and parts; its increment-decrement fixed degrees divide by three then use.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed degrees and parts, add the winter solstice ecliptic solar degrees and parts, count from the Dipper lodge initial degree until the remainder falls within a lodge, and obtain the lodge degrees and parts of retrograde motion; divide the increment-and-decrement fixed degrees by three before use.

sentences.zh: 日率度率：以本段定積減後段定積，為泛日率；

translations.literal: Day rate degree rate: subtract later segment fixed accumulation from this segment fixed accumulation, to get general day rate;
translations.idiomatic: Day rate and degree rate: subtract the later segment's fixed accumulation from this segment's fixed accumulation to obtain the general day rate;

sentences.zh: 以本段定星減後段定星，為定度率。

translations.literal: Subtract later segment fixed star from this segment fixed star, to get fixed degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the later segment's fixed star from this segment's fixed star to obtain the fixed degree rate.

sentences.zh: 又置後段甲子，以前段甲子減之，餘為距後實日率。

translations.literal: Further set later segment jiazi, subtract earlier segment jiazi, remainder is distance-to-later actual day rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the later segment's jiazi day, subtract the earlier segment's jiazi day, and the remainder gives the actual day rate to the later segment.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》以前段定積減後段定積為日率，以其段定星減後段定星為度率。

translations.literal: Qianyuan: subtract later segment fixed accumulation from earlier segment fixed accumulation for day rate, subtract later segment fixed star from its segment fixed star for degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, subtract the later segment's fixed accumulation from the earlier segment's fixed accumulation for the day rate, and subtract the later segment's fixed star from that segment's fixed star for the degree rate.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其段定日定度，以前段定日定度減之，餘者為其段日率、度率。

translations.literal: Yitian: each set its segment fixed day fixed degree, subtract earlier segment fixed day fixed degree, remainder is its segment day rate degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each segment's fixed day and fixed degree, subtract the earlier segment's fixed day and fixed degree, and the remainder gives that segment's day rate and degree rate.

sentences.zh: 其退行段，置前段定度減之，餘為退行度率。

translations.literal: Its retreat-motion segment: set earlier segment fixed degree subtract it, remainder is retreat-motion degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: For a retrograde segment, set the earlier segment's fixed degree and subtract it; the remainder is the retrograde degree rate.

sentences.zh: 平行分：《儀天》謂之求每日平行度及分。

translations.literal: Parallel parts: Yitian calls it seeking each day's parallel degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Parallel motion parts: the Yitian calendar terms this procedure "finding the daily parallel degrees and parts."

sentences.zh: 以距後日率除度率，為平行分。

translations.literal: Use distance-to-later day rate to divide degree rate, as parallel parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the degree rate by the distance-to-later day rate to obtain the parallel motion parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》以日率除度率為行分。

translations.literal: Qianyuan uses day rate to divide degree rate as motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, divide the degree rate by the day rate to obtain the motion parts.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各置其段度率及分，以其段日率除之，即得其星平行分。

translations.literal: Yitian: each set its segment degree rate and parts, divide by its segment day rate, then obtain its star parallel parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each segment's degree rate and parts, divide by that segment's day rate, and obtain the planet's parallel motion parts.

sentences.zh: 初末行分：《儀天》謂之求每段初末日度及分。

translations.literal: First-last motion parts: Yitian calls it seeking each segment first-last day degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: First and last motion parts: the Yitian calendar terms this "finding the opening and closing solar degrees and parts of each segment."

sentences.zh: 置其段平行分，與後段平行分相減，為合差；

translations.literal: Set its segment parallel parts, mutually subtract from later segment parallel parts, as aggregate difference;
translations.idiomatic: Set the segment's parallel parts and subtract the later segment's parallel parts to obtain the aggregate difference;

sentences.zh: 半之，加減平行分，為初、末行分；

translations.literal: Halve it, add-subtract parallel parts, as first, last motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: Halve it, then add to or subtract from the parallel parts to obtain the first and last motion parts;

sentences.zh: 後多者減平行分為初，加平行分為末；

translations.literal: Later more: subtract parallel parts as first, add parallel parts as last;
translations.idiomatic: If the later segment is greater, subtract the parallel parts for the first and add them for the last;

sentences.zh: 後少者加平行分為初，減平行分為末。

translations.literal: Later less: add parallel parts as first, subtract parallel parts as last.
translations.idiomatic: If the later segment is lesser, add the parallel parts for the first and subtract them for the last.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》法同。

translations.literal: Qianyuan method same.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianyuan calendar uses the same method.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》各以其段平行分與後段平行分相減，餘為會差，半會差，以加減其段平行分，余同《應天》。

translations.literal: Yitian: each by its segment parallel parts with later segment parallel parts mutually subtract, remainder as conjunction difference, half conjunction difference, to add-subtract its segment parallel parts, remainder same as Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, subtract each segment's parallel parts from the later segment's parallel parts; the remainder is the conjunction difference; halve the conjunction difference and add to or subtract from the segment's parallel parts; the rest is the same as under Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 又五星前留一段及後退段，皆加為初、減為末；

translations.literal: Further five planets' front stationary one segment and rear retreat segment, all add as first subtract as last;
translations.idiomatic: For the five planets, in a pre-stationary segment and a rear retrograde segment, always add for the first and subtract for the last;

sentences.zh: 後留一段及前退段，皆以半總差減為初、加為末。

translations.literal: Rear stationary one segment and front retreat segment, all use half total difference subtract as first add as last.
translations.idiomatic: In a post-stationary segment and a front retrograde segment, subtract half the total difference for the first and add it for the last.

sentences.zh: 其總差消息前後段初、末分，令衰殺等以用總差，即得前後段初、末行分相應也。

translations.literal: Its total difference waxes-wanes front-rear segment first-last parts, make decay kill equal to use total difference, then obtain front-rear segment first-last motion parts corresponding.
translations.idiomatic: Let the total difference wax and wane the first and last parts of the front and rear segments so that their deceleration and acceleration are equal when the total difference is applied, and the first and last motion parts of the consecutive segments will correspond.

sentences.zh: 求日差：以距後日除合差為日差。

translations.literal: Seek daily difference: use distance-to-later days to divide aggregate difference as daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily difference: divide the aggregate difference by the distance-to-later days to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》以日率除合差為日差。

translations.literal: Qianyuan uses day rate to divide aggregate difference as daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, divide the aggregate difference by the day rate to obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》置其段總差，以減其日率，一百除之，即為每日差行之分。

translations.literal: Yitian set its segment total difference, subtract its day rate, divide by 100, then is each day's differential motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, set each segment's total difference, subtract the day rate, divide by 100, and obtain the daily differential motion parts.

sentences.zh: 求每日行分：以日差後多者益、後少者損初日行分，為每日行分。

translations.literal: Seek each day's motion parts: by daily difference later more add later less reduce first-day motion parts, as each day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily motion parts: if the later segment is greater, add the daily difference to the first day's motion parts; if lesser, subtract; this gives the daily motion parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》、《儀天》法同。

translations.literal: Qianyuan, Yitian method same.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianyuan and Yitian calendars use the same method.

sentences.zh: 求每日星所在：以每日行分順加逆減其星，命如前，即得所求。

translations.literal: Seek each day's star location: by each day's motion parts forward add reverse subtract its star, order as before, then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's star position: successively add or subtract the daily motion parts from the star (adding in direct motion, subtracting in retrograde), count as before, and obtain the result sought.

sentences.zh: 其木火土水前、後遲段平行分倍之，前為初，後為末分，各以距後日除，為日差；

translations.literal: Its wood fire earth water front-rear slow segment parallel parts double them, front as first rear as last parts, each use distance-to-later days to divide, as daily difference;
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, and Mercury in front and rear slow segments, double the parallel motion parts—the front for the first and the rear for the last; divide each by the distance-to-later days to obtain the daily difference;

sentences.zh: 前遲日損、後遲日益，為每日行分。

translations.literal: Front slow days reduce rear slow days increase, as each day's motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: In front slow segments decrease daily; in rear slow segments increase daily—this yields the daily motion parts.

sentences.zh: 《乾元》以日差累損益初日行分，累加其段宿次，即得每日星行宿次及分。

translations.literal: Qianyuan by daily difference cumulatively reduce-increase first-day motion parts, cumulatively add its segment lodge sequence, then obtain each day's star motion lodge sequence and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianyuan, cumulatively add or subtract the daily difference from the first day's motion parts, and cumulatively add the segment's lodge positions to obtain each day's star lodge position and parts.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》求每日差行度及分，各置其段總差，以減其日率一日以餘之，即為每日差行之分。

translations.literal: Yitian seek each day's differential motion degrees and parts: each set its segment total difference, subtract its day rate one day with remainder, then is each day's differential motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yitian, to find the daily differential motion degrees and parts: set each segment's total difference, subtract the day rate minus one day from the remainder, and obtain the daily differential motion parts.

sentences.zh: 以每日差分累損益初日行分，為每日行度及分。

translations.literal: By each day's differential parts cumulatively reduce-increase first-day motion parts, as each day's motion degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulatively add or subtract the daily difference from the first day's motion parts to obtain each day's motion degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 初日行分多於末日行分，累損初日行分；

translations.literal: First-day motion parts more than last-day motion parts, cumulatively reduce first-day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: If the first day's motion parts exceed the last day's, cumulatively decrease the first day's motion parts;

sentences.zh: 少於末日行分，累益初日行分。

translations.literal: Less than last-day motion parts, cumulatively increase first-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: If they are less than the last day's, cumulatively increase the first day's motion parts.

sentences.zh: 將其每日行度及分累加其星初日所在宿次，各得每日所在宿次及分。

translations.literal: Take its each day's motion degrees and parts cumulatively add its star first-day lodge sequence, each obtains each day's lodge sequence and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Cumulatively add the daily motion degrees and parts to the star's lodge position on the first day to obtain each day's lodge position and parts.

sentences.zh: 如是退行段，將每日行分累減其初日宿次及分，即得退行所在宿度及分。

translations.literal: If so retreat-motion segment, take each day's motion parts cumulatively subtract its first-day lodge sequence and parts, then obtain retreat-motion lodge degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde segments, cumulatively subtract the daily motion parts from the first day's lodge position and parts to obtain the retrograde lodge degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 又《儀天》有直求其日星所在宿次，置其所求日，減一，以乘每日差分，所得為積差，以積差加減初日行分，初日多於末日減之；

translations.literal: Further Yitian has direct seek its day star lodge sequence: set day sought subtract one, multiply by each day's differential parts, obtained as accumulated difference, by accumulated difference add-subtract first-day motion parts, first day more than last day subtract;
translations.idiomatic: Yitian also has a direct method to find a given day's star lodge: set the day sought, subtract one, multiply by the daily difference to obtain the accumulated difference; adjust the first day's motion parts—subtract if the first day exceeds the last;

sentences.zh: 末日多於初日加之，即得其日行分；

translations.literal: Last day more than first day add it, then obtain its day motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: add if the last exceeds the first—to obtain that day's motion parts;

sentences.zh: 以初日行分並之，乃半之，為平行分；

translations.literal: With first-day motion parts combine them, then halve, as parallel parts;
translations.idiomatic: add to the first day's motion parts and halve to obtain the parallel motion parts;

sentences.zh: 置平行分，以求日數乘之，為積度及分；

translations.literal: Set parallel parts, by days sought multiply them, as accumulated degrees and parts;
translations.idiomatic: set the parallel motion parts, multiply by the number of days sought, and obtain the accumulated degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 以其積度及分加其星初日宿度，命去之，即其星其日所在宿次及分、如是退行段，以其積度及分減其星初日宿度，餘，為其星所在宿度及分。

translations.literal: By its accumulated degrees and parts add its star first-day lodge degrees, order remove, then its star that day lodge sequence and parts; if so retreat-motion segment, by its accumulated degrees and parts subtract its star first-day lodge degrees, remainder, as its star lodge degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: add the accumulated degrees and parts to the star's first-day lodge degree and count off the lodges to obtain that day's lodge position and parts; for retrograde segments, subtract the accumulated degrees and parts from the star's first-day lodge degree, and the remainder gives the star's lodge degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 漏刻，《周禮》，挈壺氏主挈壺水以為漏，以水火守之，分以日夜，所以視漏刻之盈縮，辨昏旦之短長。

translations.literal: Clepsydra marks, Zhou Rites: Clepsydra-Plunger office masters drawing clepsydra water as clepsydra, with fire water guard it, divide by day night, thereby observe clepsydra marks' excess deficit, distinguish dusk dawn's short long.
translations.idiomatic: Clepsydra marks: in the Zhou Rites, the Clepsydra-Plunger office drew water from vessels to measure time, guarding it with fire and water to divide day from night, thereby observing variations in the clepsydra marks and distinguishing the length of dusk and dawn.

sentences.zh: 自秦、漢至五代，典其事者，雖立法不同，而皆本于《周禮》。

translations.literal: From Qin Han to Five Dynasties, those managing its affairs, though legislating differently, all rooted in Zhou Rites.
translations.idiomatic: From the Qin and Han through the Five Dynasties, officials charged with this duty legislated differently, yet all derived their methods from the Zhou Rites.

sentences.zh: 惟後漢、隋、五代著于史志，其法甚詳，而曆載既久，傳用漸差。

translations.literal: Only Later Han, Sui, Five Dynasties recorded in history annals, its methods very detailed, yet calendar eras already long, transmission use gradually diverged.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Eastern Han, Sui, and Five Dynasties preserved detailed methods in the historical annals, but as calendar eras lengthened, transmitted practice gradually drifted.

sentences.zh: 國朝復挈壺之職，專司辰刻，署置於文德殿門內之東偏，設鼓樓、鐘樓於殿庭之左右。

translations.literal: Our dynasty restored clepsydra-plunger office, exclusively manage hours marks, office placed at Wende Hall gate inner east side, set drum tower bell tower at hall courtyard left right.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty restored the clepsydra-plunger office to oversee the hours and marks, stationed within the east side of the Wende Palace gate, with drum and bell towers set to the left and right of the palace courtyard.

sentences.zh: 其制有銅壺、水稱、渴烏、漏箭、時牌、契之屬：壺以貯水，烏以引注，稱以平其漏，箭以識其刻，牌以告時於晝，牌有七，自卯至酉用之，制以牙，刻字填金。

translations.literal: Its system has bronze vessel, water scale, thirst-bird, clepsydra arrow, time placard, tally slip and such: vessel to store water, bird to draw pour, scale to level its clepsydra, arrow to mark its marks, placard to announce time in day, placards seven, from mao to you use them, made of ivory, carved characters filled gold.
translations.idiomatic: The apparatus included bronze vessels, water scales, thirst-bird siphons, clepsydra arrows, time placards, and tally slips: vessels store water, birds draw and pour it, scales level the flow, arrows mark the divisions, and placards announce the hours by day—seven placards, from mao to you, carved in ivory with gilt-filled characters.

sentences.zh: 契以發鼓於夜，契有二：一曰放鼓。

translations.literal: Tally slip to release drum at night, tally slips two: one called drum-release.
translations.idiomatic: Tally slips trigger the drums at night; there are two kinds: one called drum-release.

sentences.zh: 二曰止鼓制以木，刻字於上。

translations.literal: Two called drum-stop made of wood, carved characters on top.
translations.idiomatic: The second is called drum-stop; it is made of wood with characters carved upon it.

sentences.zh: 常以卯正後一刻為禁門開鑰之節，盈八刻後以為辰時，每時皆然，以至於酉。

translations.literal: Constantly use mao proper after one mark as forbidden gate open key node, full eight marks after then as chen hour, each hour all so, until reaching you.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth mark after mao proper serves as the signal to open the forbidden gates and turn the keys; eight marks later marks the chen hour, and each hour follows this pattern through you.

sentences.zh: 每一時，直官進牌奏時正，雞人引唱，擊鼓一十五聲，惟午正擊鼓一百五十聲。

translations.literal: Each one hour, duty officer advance placard report time correct, cockherd lead sing, strike drum 15 sounds, only noon proper strike drum 150 sounds.
translations.idiomatic: At each hour the duty officer presents the placard announcing the correct time, the cockherd leads the chant, and drums sound fifteen times—except at noon proper, when drums sound one hundred fifty times.

sentences.zh: 至昏夜雞唱，放鼓契出，發鼓、擊鐘一百聲，然後下漏。

translations.literal: Until dusk night cock sing, drum-release tally slip out, release drum strike bell 100 sounds, then lower clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk, when cocks crow, the drum-release tally is issued, drums and bells sound one hundred times, and then the clepsydra is drained.

sentences.zh: 每夜分為五更，更分為五點，更以擊鼓為節，點以擊鐘為節。

translations.literal: Each night divided into five watches, watch divided into five points, watch by strike drum as node, point by strike bell as node.
translations.idiomatic: Each night is divided into five watches, and each watch into five points; watches are marked by drumbeats and points by bell strokes.

sentences.zh: 每更初皆雞唱，轉點即移水稱，以至五更二點，止鼓契出，凡放鼓契出，禁門外擊鼓，然後衙鼓作，止鼓契出亦然，而更鼓止焉。

translations.literal: Each watch opening all cock sing, turn point then move water scale, until fifth watch second point, drum-stop tally slip out, whenever drum-release tally slip out, outside forbidden gate strike drum, then office drum begin, drum-stop tally slip out likewise, yet watch drum stop.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of each watch cocks crow; at each point the water scale is shifted, until the second point of the fifth watch, when the drum-stop tally appears; whenever the drum-release tally is issued, drums beat outside the forbidden gates before the office drums begin, and the same when the drum-stop tally appears—then the watch drums cease.

sentences.zh: 五點擊鐘一百聲。

translations.literal: Five points strike bell 100 sounds.
translations.idiomatic: At five points the bell sounds one hundred times.

sentences.zh: 雞唱、擊鼓，是謂攢點，至八刻後為卯時正，四時皆用此法。

translations.literal: Cock sing, strike drum, this is called accumulated points, until eight marks after as mao hour proper, four seasons all use this method.
translations.idiomatic: Cockcrow and drumbeats mark the accumulated points; eight marks later is mao proper, and all four seasons use this method.
