sentences.zh: 端拱二年四月己未，翰林祗候張玭夜直禁中，太宗手詔曰：「覽《乾元曆》細行，此夕熒惑當退軫宿乃順行，今止到角宿即順行，得非曆差否？」

translations.literal: Duanguan year 2 4th month jiwei, Hanlin Attendant Zhang Bi night duty forbidden within, Taizong hand edict said: "View Qianyuan calendar fine motion, this night Mars ought retreat Chariot Shaft lodge then direct motion, now only reach Horn lodge then direct motion, perhaps not calendar error?"
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Duanguan, on jiwei day of the fourth month, Hanlin Attendant Zhang Bi was on night duty in the palace when Emperor Taizong sent a handwritten edict: "Having reviewed the fine motions in the Qianyuan calendar, Mars tonight should withdraw from the Chariot Shaft lodge and then resume direct motion; yet it has resumed direct motion upon reaching only the Horn lodge—is this not a calendar error?"

sentences.zh: 奏曰：「今夕一鼓，占熒惑在軫末、角初，順行也。

translations.literal: Memorial said: "This night first drum, observe Mars at Chariot Shaft end Horn beginning, direct motion.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized in reply: "At the first drum tonight, Mars was observed at the end of Chariot Shaft and the beginning of Horn, in direct motion.

sentences.zh: 據曆法，今月甲寅至軫十六度，乙卯順行，驗天差二度。

translations.literal: According calendar method, this month jiayin reach Chariot Shaft sixteen degrees, yimao direct motion, verify heaven differ two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the calendar method, on jiayin day of this month Mars should reach sixteen degrees into Chariot Shaft and resume direct motion on yimao day; compared with heaven, it differed by two degrees.

sentences.zh: 臣占熒惑明潤軌道，兼前歲逆出太微垣，按曆法差疾者八日，此皆上天祐德之應，非曆法之可測也。」

translations.literal: Your servant observe Mars bright moist orbit, together previous year retrograde exit Supreme Palace Enclosure, according calendar method differ fast eight days, these all above heaven bless virtue responses, not calendar method can measure."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant observed that Mars was bright and its course smooth; moreover, the year before it had emerged in retrograde from the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and by the calendar method it was eight days too fast—all of this, I submit, is a response of Heaven blessing virtue, not something calendrical methods can predict."

sentences.zh: 至道元年，昭晏又上言：「承詔考驗司天監丞王睿雍熙四年所上曆，以十八事按驗，所得者六，所失者十二。」

translations.literal: Zhidao year 1, Zhaoyan again submitted memorial: "Received edict examine verify Astronomical Bureau Vice Director Wang Rui Yongxi year 4 submitted calendar, by eighteen matters examine verify, obtained six, lost twelve."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhidao, Zhaoyan submitted another memorial: "Having received an edict to examine the calendar submitted in the fourth year of Yongxi by Vice Director Wang Rui of the Astronomical Bureau, I tested it against eighteen cases: six matched and twelve failed."

sentences.zh: 太宗嘉之，謂宰相曰：「昭晏曆術用功，考驗否臧，昭然無隱。」

translations.literal: Taizong praised it, told chief ministers said: "Zhaoyan calendar art used effort, examine verify good bad, clearly manifest no concealment."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong commended this and told the chief ministers: "Zhaoyan has applied himself diligently to calendrical science; in testing success and failure, his findings are clear and without concealment."

sentences.zh: 由是賜昭晏金紫，令兼知曆算。

translations.literal: Thereupon bestowed Zhaoyan gold purple, ordered concurrently know calendar calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he bestowed on Zhaoyan the gold-and-purple insignia and ordered him to serve concurrently as overseer of calendar calculation.

sentences.zh: 二年，屯田員外郎呂奉天上言：

translations.literal: Year 2, Field Administration Outer Gentleman Lu Fengtian submitted memorial:
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Outer Gentleman of the Field Administration Lu Fengtian submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 「按經史年曆，自漢、魏以降，雖有編聯，周、秦以前，多無甲子。

translations.literal: " Examine classics histories year calendar, from Han Wei since descending, although have compilation linkage, Zhou Qin before, mostly no sexagenary.
translations.idiomatic: "Examining the year-calendars in the classics and histories, from Han and Wei downward there are compilations and linkages, but before Zhou and Qin most lack sexagenary designations.

sentences.zh: 太史公司馬遷雖言歲次，詳求朔閏，則與經傳都不符合，乃言周武王元年歲在乙酉。

translations.literal: Grand Historian Sima Qian although spoke year sequence, detailed seek new moon intercalation, then with classics commentaries all not match, thus spoke Zhou King Wu first year year at yiyou.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Historian Sima Qian did speak of year sequences, but when one seeks the new moons and intercalations in detail, they match neither classics nor commentaries; he placed the first year of King Wu of Zhou in yiyou.

sentences.zh: 唐兵部尚書王起撰《五點陣圖》，言周桓王十年，歲在甲子，四月八日佛生，常星不見；

translations.literal: Tang Ministry of War Director Wang Qi composed Five-Point Array Diagram, spoke Zhou Duke Huan year 10, year at jiazi, 4th month 8th day Buddha born, ordinary stars not seen;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qi, Director of the Tang Ministry of War, composed the Five-Point Array Diagram, placing Duke Huan of Zhou's tenth year in jiazi and the Buddha's birth on the eighth day of the fourth month, when ordinary stars were not seen;

sentences.zh: 又言孔子生於周靈王庚戌之歲，卒于周悼王四十一年壬戌之歲，皆非是也。

translations.literal: Also spoke Confucius born at Zhou King Ling gengxu year, died at Zhou King Dao year 41 renxu year, all not correct.
translations.idiomatic: he also placed Confucius's birth in the gengxu year of King Ling of Zhou and his death in the forty-first year of King Dao of Zhou, the renxu year—all of which is incorrect.

sentences.zh: 馬遷乃古之良史，王起又近世名儒，後人因循，莫敢改易。

translations.literal: Qian was ancient good historian, Wang Qi also recent famous scholar, later people follow precedent, none dare change alter.
translations.idiomatic: Qian was a fine historian of antiquity and Wang Qi a renowned scholar of recent times; later men followed their lead and none dared to change it.

sentences.zh: 臣竊以史氏凡編一年，則有一十二月，月有晦朔、氣閏，則須與歲次合同，苟不合同，何名歲次？

translations.literal: Your servant privately consider historians whenever compile one year, then have twelve months, month has dark new moon qi intercalation, then must with year sequence agree, if not agree, what call year sequence?
translations.idiomatic: Your servant holds that whenever historians compile a year, it must contain twelve months, and the months must have dark moons, new moons, qi nodes, and intercalations that agree with the year sequence—if they do not agree, how can it be called a year sequence?

sentences.zh: 本朝文教聿興，禮樂鹹備，惟此一事，久未刊詳。

translations.literal: This dynasty culture teaching flourish rise, rites music all complete, only this one matter, long not publish detail.
translations.idiomatic: In our dynasty culture and teaching flourish and rites and music are fully in place, yet this one matter has long gone uncorrected in detail.

sentences.zh: 臣探索百家，用心十載，乃知唐堯即位之年，歲在丙子，迄太平興國元年，亦在丙子，凡三千三百一年矣。

translations.literal: Your servant explore hundred schools, use mind ten years, then know Tang Yao accede throne year, year at bingzi, until Taiping Xingguo year 1, also at bingzi, total three thousand three hundred one years.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has explored the hundred schools and applied himself for ten years, and thereby learned that the year in which Tang Yao acceded to the throne was bingzi, and that down to the first year of Taiping Xingguo is also bingzi—a span of three thousand three hundred and one years.

sentences.zh: 虞、夏之間，未有甲子可證，成湯既沒，太甲元年始有二月乙丑朔旦冬至，伊尹祀于先王，至武王伐商之年正月辛卯朔，二十有八日戊午，二月五日甲子昧爽。

translations.literal: Yu Xia between, not yet sexagenary can verify, Cheng Tang already died, Taijia year 1 first have 2nd month yichou new moon dawn winter solstice, Yi Yin sacrifice at former kings, until King Wu attack Shang year 1st month xinmao new moon, twenty have eight days wuwu, 2nd month 5th day jiazi before dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Between Yu and Xia there is no sexagenary proof; after Cheng Tang's death, the first year of Taijia first yields the second month, yichou new moon at dawn on the winter solstice, when Yi Yin sacrificed to the former kings; down to the year King Wu attacked Shang, the first month had xinmao new moon, and on the twenty-eighth day, wuwu, and on the fifth day of the second month, jiazi, before dawn.

sentences.zh: 又康王十二年六月戊辰朔，三日庚午朏，王命作冊畢。

translations.literal: Also King Kang year 12 6th month wuchen new moon, 3rd day gengwu crescent, king ordered compose document Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Also in the twelfth year of King Kang, the sixth month had wuchen new moon; on the third day, gengwu, at the crescent moon, the king ordered the composition of the Document of Bi.

sentences.zh: 自堯即位年，距春秋魯隱西元年，凡一千六百七年；

translations.literal: From Yao accede throne year, distance Spring Autumn Lu Yin first year, total one thousand six hundred seven years;
translations.idiomatic: From the year of Yao's accession to the first year of Duke Yin of Lu in the Spring and Autumn Annals is one thousand six hundred and seven years;

sentences.zh: 從隱西元年，距今至道二年，凡一千七百一十五年；

translations.literal: From Yin first year, distance now Zhidao year 2, total one thousand seven hundred fifteen years;
translations.idiomatic: from Duke Yin's first year to the present, the second year of Zhidao, is one thousand seven hundred and fifteen years;

sentences.zh: 從太甲元年，距今至道二年，凡二千七百三十二年；

translations.literal: From Taijia year 1, distance now Zhidao year 2, total two thousand seven hundred thirty-two years;
translations.idiomatic: from the first year of Taijia to the present, the second year of Zhidao, is two thousand seven hundred and thirty-two years;

sentences.zh: 從魯莊公七年四月辛卯夜常星不見，距今至道二年，凡一千六百八十一年，從周靈王二十年孔子生，其年九月庚戌、十月庚辰兩朔頻食，距今至道二年，凡一千五百四十五年；

translations.literal: From Lu Duke Zhuang year 7 4th month xinmao night ordinary stars not seen, distance now Zhidao year 2, total one thousand six hundred eighty-one years, from Zhou King Ling year 20 Confucius born, its year 9th month gengxu 10th month gengchen two new moons frequent eclipses, distance now Zhidao year 2, total one thousand five hundred forty-five years;
translations.idiomatic: from the night in the fourth month, xinmao, of the seventh year of Duke Zhuang of Lu, when ordinary stars were not seen, to the present, the second year of Zhidao, is one thousand six hundred and eighty-one years; from the twentieth year of King Ling of Zhou, when Confucius was born—in that year the new moons of the ninth month, gengxu, and the tenth month, gengchen, suffered frequent eclipses—to the present, the second year of Zhidao, is one thousand five hundred and forty-five years;

sentences.zh: 從魯哀公十六年四月乙丑孔子卒，距今至道二年，凡一千四百七十二年。

translations.literal: From Lu Duke Ai year 16 4th month yichou Confucius died, distance now Zhidao year 2, total one thousand four hundred seventy-two years.
translations.idiomatic: From the death of Confucius on yichou in the fourth month of the sixteenth year of Duke Ai of Lu to the present, the second year of Zhidao, is one thousand four hundred and seventy-two years.

sentences.zh: 以上並據經傳正文，用古曆推校，無不符合，乃知《史記》及《五點陣圖》所編之年，殊為闊略。

translations.literal: Above all based on classics commentaries main text, use ancient calendar calculate verify, none not conform, then know Records and Five-Point Array Diagram compiled years, especially broad brief.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above is based on the main text of the classics and commentaries and verified by the ancient calendar, with nothing inconsistent—whereby one knows that the years compiled in the Records of the Grand Historian and Wang Qi's Diagram of the Five Night Watches are exceedingly broad and rough.

sentences.zh: 諸如此事，觸類甚多，若盡披陳，恐煩聖覽。

translations.literal: Such like matters, touch categories very many, if exhaust display set forth, fear trouble sagely perusal.
translations.idiomatic: Matters such as these, by analogy, are very numerous; if I were to lay them all bare, I fear I would weary Your Majesty's reading.

sentences.zh: 臣耽研既久，引證尤明，起商王小甲七年二月甲申朔旦冬至，自此之後，每七十六年一得朔旦冬至，此乃古曆一蔀；

translations.literal: Your servant devoted study already long, cite proof especially clear, starting Shang king Xiao Jia year 7 2nd month jiashen new moon dawn winter solstice, from this after, every seventy-six years one obtain new moon dawn winter solstice, this is ancient calendar one obscuration;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has long devoted himself to this research, and the citations are especially clear: starting from the winter solstice at dawn on the new moon, jiashen, of the second month of the seventh year of King Xiao Jia of Shang, thereafter a new-moon dawn winter solstice occurs every seventy-six years—this is one obscuration of the ancient calendar;

sentences.zh: 每蔀積月九百四十、積日二萬七千七百五十九，率以為常，直至《春秋》魯僖公五年正月辛亥朔旦冬至，了無差爽。

translations.literal: Each obscuration accumulated months nine hundred forty accumulated days twenty-seven thousand seven hundred fifty-nine, rate take as constant, straight until Spring Autumn Lu Duke Xi year 5 1st month xinhai new moon dawn winter solstice, entirely no discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: each obscuration accumulates nine hundred and forty months and twenty-seven thousand seven hundred and fifty-nine days, taken as the constant rule, down to the winter solstice at dawn on the new moon, xinhai, of the first month of the fifth year of Duke Xi of Lu in the Spring and Autumn Annals, without the slightest discrepancy.

sentences.zh: 用此為法，以推經傳，縱小有增減，抑又經傳之誤，皆可以發明也。

translations.literal: Use this as method, thereby extrapolate classics commentaries, even if small have increase decrease, or again classics commentaries errors, all can by clarify.
translations.idiomatic: Using this as the method to extrapolate the classics and commentaries, even where there are slight additions or subtractions—or indeed errors in the classics and commentaries—all can be clarified.

sentences.zh: 古曆到齊、梁以來，或差一日，更有近曆校課，亦得符合。

translations.literal: Ancient calendar until Qi Liang since, sometimes off one day, further have recent calendar verify test, also obtain conform.
translations.idiomatic: From Qi and Liang down, the ancient calendar sometimes differed by a day; tested against more recent calendars, it also accords.

sentences.zh: 伏望聖慈，許臣撰集，不出百日，其書必成。

translations.literal: Humbly hope sagely grace, permit your servant compile collect, not exceed hundred days, its book surely complete.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope for Your Majesty's gracious permission to compile and gather this material; within a hundred days the work will surely be finished.

sentences.zh: 儻有可觀，願藏秘府。」

translations.literal: If perchance have worth viewing, wish store secret archives."
translations.idiomatic: If it proves at all worth reading, I ask that it be preserved in the imperial archives."

sentences.zh: 詔許之。

translations.literal: Edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 書終不就。

translations.literal: Book ultimately not accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: The book was never completed.

sentences.zh: 又司天冬官正楊文鎰上言：「新曆甲子，請以百二十年。」

translations.literal: Also Director of Astronomy Bureau Yang Wenyi memorialized saying: "New calendar sexagenary cycle, request use one hundred twenty years."
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Astronomy Bureau, Yang Wenyi, also memorialized, saying, "For the sexagenary cycle of the new calendar, I ask that one hundred and twenty years be used."

sentences.zh: 事下有司，以其無所依據，議寢不行。

translations.literal: Matter sent down responsible offices, because its nothing basis rely on, deliberation suspended not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the responsible offices; because it had no basis, discussion suspended it and it was not implemented.

sentences.zh: 太宗曰：「支幹相承，雖止於六十，儻再周甲子，成上壽之數，使期頤之人得見所生之年，不亦善乎？」

translations.literal: Taizong said: "Stem-branch mutual succeed, although stop at sixty, if again cycle sexagenary, complete upper longevity number, make centenarians obtain see born year, not also good?"
translations.idiomatic: Taizong said, "The stems and branches succeed one another, stopping at sixty cycles; yet if the sexagenary cycle were run through twice, reaching the number of great longevity, so that men of a hundred years could see the year of their birth—would that not be well?"

sentences.zh: 遂詔新曆甲子所紀百二十歲。

translations.literal: Then edicted new calendar sexagenary cycle recorded one hundred twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly an edict ordered that the sexagenary cycle recorded in the new calendar should span one hundred and twenty years.

sentences.zh: 國初，有司上言：「國家受周禪，周木德，木生火，則本朝運膺火德，色當尚赤。

translations.literal: State beginning, responsible officials memorialized: "State received Zhou abdication, Zhou wood virtue wood generates fire, then this dynasty fortune receive fire virtue, color ought esteem red.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the state, the responsible officials memorialized: "Our realm received the abdication of Zhou; Zhou held the virtue of Wood, and Wood generates Fire; therefore our dynasty's destiny receives the virtue of Fire, and the color it should honor is red.

sentences.zh: 臘以戌日。」

translations.literal: La sacrifice on xu day."
translations.idiomatic: The La sacrifice should be on a xu day."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: Edict followed it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this.

sentences.zh: 雍熙元年四月，布衣趙垂慶上書言：「本朝當越五代而上承唐統為金德，若梁繼唐，傳後唐，至本朝亦合為金德。

translations.literal: Yongxi year 1 4th month, commoner Zhao Chuiqing submitted memorial saying: "This dynasty ought leap Five Dynasties and above inherit Tang lineage as metal virtue, if Liang succeed Tang, transmit Later Tang, until this dynasty also ought metal virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Yongxi, the commoner Zhao Chuiqing submitted a memorial stating, "Our dynasty ought to skip over the Five Dynasties and inherit the Tang line as the virtue of Metal; if Liang succeeded Tang and passed the throne to Later Tang, down to our dynasty it would likewise accord with Metal.

sentences.zh: 矧自國初符瑞色白者不可勝紀，皆金德之應也。

translations.literal: Moreover from state beginning auspicious omens color white ones cannot count all record, all metal virtue responses.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, from the founding of the state, white auspicious omens too numerous to record have all been responses of the virtue of Metal.

sentences.zh: 望改正朔，易車旗服色，以承天統。」

translations.literal: Hope correct first month new moon, change chariots banners clothing colors, thereby inherit heaven lineage."
translations.idiomatic: I hope the calendar will be corrected, and the colors of chariots, banners, and robes changed, to inherit Heaven's mandate."

sentences.zh: 事下尚書省集議，常侍徐鉉與百官奏議曰：「五運相承，國家大事，著於前載，具有明文。

translations.literal: Matter sent down Ministry of Personnel collective deliberation, Regular Attendant Xu Xuan with hundred officials memorial deliberation said: "Five phases mutual succeed, state great matter, recorded in previous records, complete have clear text.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was sent to the Ministry of Personnel for collective deliberation; Regular Attendant Xu Xuan and the officials submitted a deliberation: "The succession of the Five Phases is a great matter of state, recorded in earlier histories with clear textual authority.

sentences.zh: 頃以唐末喪亂，朱梁篡弑，莊宗早編屬籍，親雪國仇，中興唐祚，重新土運，以梁室比羿、浞、王莽，不為正統。

translations.literal: Recently because Tang end mourning chaos, Zhu Liang usurpation regicide, Zhuangzong early compiled genealogy rolls, personally avenge state enmity, central flourish Tang throne, anew establish earth cycle, take Liang house compare Yi Zhuo Wang Mang, not as orthodox lineage.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, because of the disorders at the end of Tang, when Zhu's Liang usurped and slew the throne, Emperor Zhuangzong had long been enrolled in the imperial genealogy; he personally avenged the state's wrong and restored the house of Tang, reestablishing the cycle of Earth—placing the house of Liang alongside Yi, Zhuo, and Wang Mang and denying it orthodox standing.

sentences.zh: 自後數姓相傳，晉以金，漢以水，周以木，天造有宋，運膺火德。

translations.literal: From after several surnames mutual transmit, Jin with metal, Han with water, Zhou with wood, Heaven made have Song, fortune receive fire virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter several houses succeeded one another: Jin with Metal, Han with Water, Zhou with Wood—and Heaven produced Song, whose destiny receives the virtue of Fire.

sentences.zh: 況國初祀赤帝為感生帝，於今二十五年，豈可輕議改易？」

translations.literal: Moreover state beginning sacrifice Red Emperor as Spirit-of-Birth Emperor, until now twenty-five years, how can lightly deliberation change alter?"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, from the founding we have sacrificed to the Red Emperor as the Spirit-of-Birth Emperor—for twenty-five years now—how can this be lightly debated and changed?"

sentences.zh: 又云：「梁至周不合迭居五運，欲國家繼唐統為金德，且五運迭遷，親承歷數，質文相次，間不容髮，豈可越數姓之上，繼百年之運？

translations.literal: Also said: "Liang until Zhou not fit alternate occupy Five Phases, wish state inherit Tang lineage as metal virtue, moreover Five Phases alternate shift, personally inherit heavenly mandate sequence, substance pattern mutual succeed, interval not permit hair, how can leap several surnames above, inherit hundred-year cycle?
translations.idiomatic: They also said, "From Liang through Zhou does not fit sequential occupation of the Five Phases. To wish our state to inherit the Tang line as Metal, moreover—the Phases shift in turn, each directly receiving the heavenly sequence, substance and pattern succeeding without the interval of a hair—how could one leap over several houses and inherit a cycle of a hundred years?

sentences.zh: 此不可之甚也。

translations.literal: This not possible extremely.
translations.idiomatic: This is utterly inadmissible.

sentences.zh: 按《唐書》天寶九載，崔昌獻議自魏、晉至周、隋，皆不得為正統，欲唐遠繼漢統，立周、漢子孫為王者後，備三恪之禮。

translations.literal: According Tang Book Tianbao year 9, Cui Chang offered deliberation from Wei Jin until Zhou Sui all not obtain as orthodox lineage, wish Tang far inherit Han lineage, establish Zhou Han descendants as kings' successors, complete Three Respectful rites.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Book of Tang, in the ninth year of Tianbao Cui Chang offered a deliberation that from Wei and Jin through Zhou and Sui none might count as orthodox lineage; he wished Tang to inherit the Han line from afar, installing descendants of Zhou and Han as successors of kings, fulfilling the rites of the Three Respectful Lines.

sentences.zh: 是時，朝議是非相半，集賢院學士衛包上言符同，李林甫遂行其事。

translations.literal: This time, court deliberation yes no half each, Academy Scholar Wei Bao memorialized accord same, Li Linfu then implement its matter.
translations.idiomatic: At that time court opinion was evenly divided; Academy Scholar Wei Bao memorialized in agreement, and Li Linfu thereupon carried it out.

sentences.zh: 至十二載，林甫卒，復以魏、周、隋之後為三恪，崔昌、衛包由是遠貶，此又前載之甚明也。

translations.literal: Until year 12, Linfu died, again take Wei Zhou Sui successors as Three Respectful, Cui Chang Wei Bao thereby far demoted, this again previous records extremely clear.
translations.idiomatic: By the twelfth year Linfu died, and Wei, Zhou, and Sui successors were again made the Three Respectful Lines; Cui Chang and Wei Bao were thereby banished far away—another precedent made very clear in earlier records.

sentences.zh: 伏請祗守舊章，以承天祐。」

translations.literal: Humbly request reverently guard old statutes, thereby inherit heaven protection."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly ask that the old statutes be reverently upheld, to inherit Heaven's protection."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was accepted.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符三年，開封府功曹參軍張君房上言：「自唐室下衰，土德隤圮，朱氏強稱金統，而莊宗旋復舊邦，則朱梁氏不入正統明矣。

translations.literal: Dazhong Xiangfu year 3, Kaifeng Prefecture Merit Officer Zhang Junfang memorialized: "From Tang house decline fall, earth virtue collapse ruin, Zhu house forcibly called metal lineage, while Zhuangzong soon restore old state, then Zhu Liang house not enter orthodox lineage clear already.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Merit Officer Zhang Junfang of Kaifeng Prefecture memorialized: "From the decline of the house of Tang, when the virtue of Earth crumbled, the house of Zhu forcibly claimed the Metal succession; yet Emperor Zhuangzong soon restored the old realm—thus the house of Zhu's Liang clearly did not enter the orthodox succession.

sentences.zh: 晉氏又復稱金，蓋謂乘于唐氏，殊不知李?建國於江南耳。

translations.literal: Jin house again restore call metal, probably say ride on Tang house, utterly not know Li Bian establish state at Jiangnan only.
translations.idiomatic: Jin again claimed Metal, supposing it succeeded the house of Tang—utterly unaware that Li Bian had established a state only in the south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 漢家二主，共止三年，紹晉而興，是為水德。

translations.literal: Han house two rulers, together only three years, continue Jin and rise, this is water virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Han had two rulers totaling only three years, rising as successor to Jin—this was the virtue of Water.

sentences.zh: 洎廣順革命，二主九年，終於顯德。

translations.literal: Until Guangshun revolution, two rulers nine years, ended at Xiande.
translations.idiomatic: From the Guangshun revolution, two rulers over nine years, ending in Xiande.

sentences.zh: 以上三朝七主，共止二十四年，行運之間，陰隱而難賾。

translations.literal: Above three dynasties seven rulers, together only twenty-four years, running cycles between, hidden obscure and hard trace.
translations.idiomatic: The above three dynasties and seven rulers together lasted only twenty-four years; among their shifting cycles, the phases lie hidden and are hard to discern.

sentences.zh: 伏自太祖承周木德而王，當於火行，上系于商，開國在宋，自是三朝迄今以為然矣。

translations.literal: Humbly from Taizu inherit Zhou wood virtue and king, ought at fire phase, above tie at Shang, establish nation at Song, from this three dynasties until now take as so already.
translations.idiomatic: From the time when Taizu received Zhou's virtue of Wood and became king—fittingly belonging to the phase of Fire, connected above to Shang, founding the state in Song—the three dynasties down to the present have taken this as settled.

sentences.zh: 愚臣詳而辨之，若可疑者。

translations.literal: Foolish your servant detail and distinguish it, as if doubtful points.
translations.idiomatic: This foolish servant has examined and distinguished the matter, and there are points that seem doubtful.

sentences.zh: 太祖禪周之歲，歲在庚申。

translations.literal: Taizu abdicate Zhou year, year at gengshen.
translations.idiomatic: The year Taizu received Zhou's abdication was gengshen.

sentences.zh: 夫庚者，金也，申亦金位，納音是木，蓋周氏稱木，為二金所勝之象也。

translations.literal: As-for geng is, metal also, shen also metal position, received sound is wood, probably Zhou house called wood, as two metals overcome image.
translations.idiomatic: Geng is Metal, and shen is also a Metal position; the received tone is Wood—Zhou claimed Wood, and this is the image of two Metals overcoming it.

sentences.zh: 太宗登極之後，詔開金明池于金方之上，此誰啟之？

translations.literal: Taizong ascend throne after, edicted open Jinming Pool at metal direction above, this who initiated it?
translations.idiomatic: After Taizong ascended the throne, he ordered Jinming Pool opened in the direction of Metal—who initiated this?

sentences.zh: 乃天之靈符也。

translations.literal: Thus heaven's spirit tally.
translations.idiomatic: It was Heaven's spiritual token.

sentences.zh: 陛下履極當強圉之歲，握符在作噩之春，適宋道之隆興，得金天之正氣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty tread throne at qiangyu year, grasp tally at zuoe spring, exactly Song way grand rise, obtain metal heaven correct qi.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty took the throne in the year qiangyu, grasping the mandate in the spring of zuoe—just as Song's Way rose gloriously, receiving the correct qi of Metal and Heaven.

sentences.zh: 臣試以瑞應言之，則當年丹徒貢白鹿，姑蘇進白龜，條支之雀來，潁川之雉至。

translations.literal: Your servant try with auspicious responses speak it, then that year Dantu tribute white deer, Gusu present white turtle, Tiaozhi sparrow come, Yingchuan pheasant arrive.
translations.idiomatic: If I speak of auspicious responses, that year Dantu presented a white deer, Gusu offered a white turtle, a sparrow from Tiaozhi came, and pheasants from Yingchuan arrived.

sentences.zh: 臣又聞當封禪之時，魯郊貢白兔，鄆上得金龜，皆金符之至驗也。

translations.literal: Your servant also heard at fengshan time, Lu outskirts tribute white rabbit, Yun above obtain gold turtle, all metal tokens utmost verification.
translations.idiomatic: I also heard that at the time of the feng and shan rites, the Lu outskirts presented a white rabbit, and on Yun a golden turtle was found—all supreme verification of Metal tokens.

sentences.zh: 願以臣章下三事大臣，參定其事。」

translations.literal: Wish your servant chapter sent down Three Affairs great ministers, jointly determine its matter."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that my memorial be sent down to the grand ministers of the Three Bureaus to jointly determine the matter."

sentences.zh: 疏奏，不報。

translations.literal: Memorial submitted, no response.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and received no reply.

sentences.zh: 天禧四年，光祿寺丞謝絳上書曰：

translations.literal: Tianxi year 4, Court of Imperial Sacrifices Assistant Director Xie Jiang submitted memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tianxi, Assistant Director Xie Jiang of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted a memorial, saying:

sentences.zh: 臣按古志，凡帝王之興，必推五行之盛德，所以配天地而符陰陽也。

translations.literal: Your servant according ancient records, every emperor king rise, must extrapolate Five Phases flourishing virtue, therefore match heaven earth and tally yin yang.
translations.idiomatic: According to the ancient records, whenever an emperor rises he must claim the flourishing virtue of one of the Five Phases, thereby matching Heaven and Earth and tallying with Yin and Yang.

sentences.zh: 故神農氏以火德，聖祖以土德，夏以木德，商以金德，周以火德。

translations.literal: Therefore Shennong clan with fire virtue, Sacred Ancestor with earth virtue, Xia with wood virtue, Shang with metal virtue, Zhou with fire virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the clan of Shennong took Fire; the Sacred Ancestor took Earth; Xia took Wood; Shang took Metal; Zhou took Fire.

sentences.zh: 自漢之興，王火德者，以謂承堯之後。

translations.literal: From Han rise, claim fire virtue ones, because say inherit Yao after.
translations.idiomatic: From the rise of Han, those who claimed the virtue of Fire did so on the ground that they succeeded Yao.

sentences.zh: 且漢，堯之裔也。

translations.literal: Moreover Han, Yao's descendant.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Han was descended from Yao.

sentences.zh: 五帝之大，莫大於堯，漢能因之，是不墜其緒而善繼其盛德也。

translations.literal: Five Emperors greatness, none greater than Yao, Han able follow it, this is not drop its thread and well inherit its flourishing virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Among the Five Emperors, none was greater than Yao; Han was able to follow him—thus not dropping his thread and well inheriting his flourishing virtue.

sentences.zh: 國家膺開光之慶，執敦厚之德，宜以土瑞而王天下，然其推終始傳，承周之木德而火當其次。

translations.literal: State received Kaiguang celebration, hold sincere thick virtue, ought with earth auspice and king all under heaven, yet its extrapolate end beginning transmit, inherit Zhou wood virtue and fire ought its next.
translations.idiomatic: Our state received the blessing of founding splendor and holds sincere, steadfast virtue; it ought to take the earthly auspice and rule all under Heaven—yet by reckoning end and beginning, having inherited Zhou's virtue of Wood, Fire comes next.

sentences.zh: 且朱梁不預正統者，謂莊宗復興於後。

translations.literal: Moreover Zhu Liang not participate orthodox lineage, say Zhuangzong restore flourish at after.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Zhu's Liang is excluded from the orthodox succession because Zhuangzong restored the realm afterward.

sentences.zh: 自石晉、漢氏以及于周，則李昪建國于江左而唐祚未絕，是三代者亦不得正其統矣。

translations.literal: From Stone Jin Han clan and until Zhou, then Li Bian establish state at river left and Tang throne not ended, these three dynasties also not obtain correct their lineage.
translations.idiomatic: From Later Jin and Han down to Zhou, Li Bian established a state on the left bank of the river while the fortune of Tang had not expired—thus these three dynasties also cannot be made orthodox.

sentences.zh: 昔者，秦祚促而德暴，不入正統，考諸五代之際，亦是類矣。

translations.literal: Formerly, Qin throne short and virtue violent, not enter orthodox lineage, examine all Five Dynasties period, also is same kind.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Qin's reign was brief and its virtue harsh, and it did not enter the orthodox succession; considering the period of the Five Dynasties, the cases are of the same kind.

sentences.zh: 國家誠能下黜五代，紹唐之土德，以繼聖祖，亦猶漢之黜秦，興周之火德以繼堯者也。

translations.literal: State truly able dismiss Five Dynasties, continue Tang earth virtue, thereby inherit Sacred Ancestor, also like Han dismiss Qin, rise Zhou fire virtue thereby inherit Yao.
translations.idiomatic: If our state could truly set aside the Five Dynasties, renew Tang's virtue of Earth, and thereby succeed the Sacred Ancestor, it would be as when Han dismissed Qin and raised Zhou's virtue of Fire to succeed Yao.

sentences.zh: 夫五行定位，土德居中，國家飛運于宋，作京於汴，誠萬國之中區矣。

translations.literal: Now Five Phases fix positions, earth virtue at center, state fly fortune at Song, make capital at Bian, truly ten thousand states center region.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Phases have fixed positions, with Earth at the center; our state's ascending fortune is in Song, with the capital at Bian—truly the central region of the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：「土為群物主，故曰後土。」

translations.literal: Commentary says: "Earth is all things lord, therefore called Queen Earth."
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary says, "Earth is lord of the myriad things, and is therefore called Queen Earth."

sentences.zh: 《洪範》曰「土爰稼穡，稼穡作甘。」

translations.literal: Great Plan says "Earth then crops sow harvest, crops sow harvest make sweet."
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan says, "Earth is the field of sowing and harvest; sowing and harvest yield sweetness."

sentences.zh: 方今四海給足，嘉生蕃衍，邇年京師甘露下，泰山醴泉湧，作甘之兆，斯亦見矣。

translations.literal: Now four seas supply sufficient, fine life multiply spread, recent years capital sweet dew descend, Mount Tai sweet spring surge, make sweet omen, this also seen already.
translations.idiomatic: At present the four seas are abundantly supplied and life flourishes; in recent years sweet dew has fallen on the capital and sweet springs have welled at Mount Tai—the omen of yielding sweetness is already manifest.

sentences.zh: 矧靈木異卉，資生於土，千品萬類，不可勝道，非土德之驗乎？

translations.literal: Moreover spirit trees exotic flowers, rely life at earth, thousand kinds myriad categories, cannot exhaust speak, not earth virtue verification?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, sacred trees and exotic plants live by relying on Earth—thousands upon myriad kinds too numerous to tell—are these not verification of the virtue of Earth?

sentences.zh: 臣又聞之，太祖生於洛邑，而胞絡惟黃；

translations.literal: Your servant also heard it, Taizu born at Luoyang, and fetal membrane only yellow;
translations.idiomatic: I have also heard that Taizu was born in the capital at Luoyi, his afterbirth entirely yellow;

sentences.zh: 鴻圖既建，五緯聚於奎躔，而鎮星是主。

translations.literal: Grand design already established, five cords gather at Kui mansion, and Station Star is master.
translations.idiomatic: once the grand design was established, the five cords gathered at the Kui asterism, with the Station Star as master.

sentences.zh: 及陛下升中之次，日抱黃珥；

translations.literal: Until Your Majesty feng ascent time, sun embrace yellow ear;
translations.idiomatic: and when Your Majesty performed the feng ascent, the sun wore yellow halos;

sentences.zh: 朝祀于太清宮，有星曰含輿，其色黃而潤澤。

translations.literal: Morning sacrifice at Grand Pure Palace, have star called Cart-of-Harmony, its color yellow and lustrous moist.
translations.idiomatic: while performing morning rites at the Palace of Grand Purity, there was a star called Harmon's Cart, yellow and lustrous.

sentences.zh: 斯皆凝命有表，微德攸屬，天意人事響效之大者，則土德之符在矣。

translations.literal: These all condensed mandate have manifestation, subtle virtue whereby belong, heaven intent human affairs echo response great ones, then earth virtue tokens exist already.
translations.idiomatic: These are all great manifestations of a concentrated mandate, to which subtle virtue belongs—great echoes between Heaven's intent and human affairs—whereby the tokens of Earth are present.

sentences.zh: 是故天心之在茲，陛下拒而罔受；

translations.literal: Therefore heaven heart at this, Your Majesty reject and not receive;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, though Heaven's heart is here, Your Majesty has refused and not accepted;

sentences.zh: 民意之若是，陛下謙而弗答。

translations.literal: People intent such as this, Your Majesty modest and not respond.
translations.idiomatic: and though the people's intent is thus, Your Majesty has been modest and not answered.

sentences.zh: 氣壅未宣，河決遂潰，豈不神哉！

translations.literal: Qi blocked not released, river burst then breach, how not divine!
translations.idiomatic: Qi blocked and unreleased, the river's dike then burst—is this not divine!

sentences.zh: 然則天淵之勃流，水德之浸患，考六府之厭鎮，驗五行之勝剋，亦宜興土之運，禦時之災。

translations.literal: Then heaven abyss surge flow, water virtue inundate calamity, examine six treasuries suppress secure, verify Five Phases overcome restrain, also ought rise earth cycle, defend time calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Then—the surging flood of the heavenly abyss, the inundating calamity of Water's virtue—examining how the six treasuries are to be suppressed and secured and verifying how the Five Phases overcome and restrain, one ought also to raise the cycle of Earth to ward off the calamity of the age.

sentences.zh: 伏望順考符應，詳習法度，惟陛下時而行之。

translations.literal: Humbly hope follow examine tokens responses, detail study laws standards, only Your Majesty time and implement it.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope Your Majesty will accord with these tokens and responses, examine the laws in detail, and act at the proper time.

sentences.zh: 大理寺丞董行父又上言曰：「在昔泰皇以萬物生於東，至仁體乎木，故德始於木。

translations.literal: Grand Court of Justice Assistant Director Dong Xingfu again memorialized saying: "In past Supreme Sovereign because ten thousand things born at east, utmost benevolence body at wood, therefore virtue start at wood.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Director Dong Xingfu of the Grand Court of Justice also memorialized, saying, "Of old the Supreme Sovereign, because the myriad things are born in the east and utmost benevolence is embodied in Wood, therefore virtue began with Wood.

sentences.zh: 木以生火，神農受之為火德；

translations.literal: Wood thereby generate fire, Shennong received it as fire virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Wood generates Fire, and Shennong received it as the virtue of Fire;

sentences.zh: 火以生土，黃帝受之為土德；

translations.literal: Fire thereby generate earth, Yellow Emperor received it as earth virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Fire generates Earth, and the Yellow Emperor received it as the virtue of Earth;

sentences.zh: 土以生金，少昊受之為金德；

translations.literal: Earth thereby generate metal, Shaohao received it as metal virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Earth generates Metal, and Shaohao received it as the virtue of Metal;

sentences.zh: 金以生水，顓頊受之為水德；

translations.literal: Metal thereby generate water, Zhuanxu received it as water virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Metal generates Water, and Zhuanxu received it as the virtue of Water;

sentences.zh: 水以生木，高辛受之為木德；

translations.literal: Water thereby generate wood, Gaoxin received it as wood virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Water generates Wood, and Gaoxin received it as the virtue of Wood;

sentences.zh: 木以生火，唐堯受之為火德；

translations.literal: Wood thereby generate fire, Tang Yao received it as fire virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Wood generates Fire, and Tang Yao received it as the virtue of Fire;

sentences.zh: 火以生土，虞舜傳之為土德。

translations.literal: Fire thereby generate earth, Yu Shun transmitted it as earth virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Fire generates Earth, and Yu Shun handed it down as the virtue of Earth.

sentences.zh: 土以生金，夏為金德；

translations.literal: Earth thereby generate metal, Xia as metal virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Earth generates Metal; Xia took Metal;

sentences.zh: 金以生水，商為水德；

translations.literal: Metal thereby generate water, Shang as water virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Metal generates Water; Shang took Water;

sentences.zh: 水以生木，周為木德；

translations.literal: Water thereby generate wood, Zhou as wood virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Water generates Wood; Zhou took Wood;

sentences.zh: 木以生火，漢應圖讖為火德；

translations.literal: Wood thereby generate fire, Han responded charts prophecies as fire virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Wood generates Fire; Han answered the charts and prophecies as the virtue of Fire;

sentences.zh: 火以生土，唐受曆運為土德。

translations.literal: Fire thereby generate earth, Tang received calendar fortune as earth virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Fire generates Earth; Tang received the calendar fortune as the virtue of Earth.

sentences.zh: 陛下紹天之統，受天之命，固當上繼唐祚，以金為德，顯黃帝之嫡緒，彰聖祖之丕烈。

translations.literal: Your Majesty continue heaven lineage, receive heaven mandate, solidly ought above inherit Tang throne, with metal as virtue, display Yellow Emperor direct thread, manifest Sacred Ancestor great glory.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty continues Heaven's lineage and receives Heaven's mandate; you ought indeed to succeed the fortune of Tang above, taking Metal as your virtue, displaying the direct line of the Yellow Emperor and manifesting the great glory of the Sacred Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 臣又按聖祖先降于癸酉，太祖受禪于庚申，陛下即位于丁酉，天書下降于戊申。

translations.literal: Your servant also according Sacred Ancestor first descend at guiyou, Taizu receive abdication at gengshen, Your Majesty accede throne at dingyou, heaven book descend at wushen.
translations.idiomatic: I also note that the Sacred Ancestor first descended on guiyou; Taizu received the abdication on gengshen; Your Majesty acceded to the throne on dingyou; and the heavenly writ descended on wushen.

sentences.zh: 庚，金也，申、酉皆金也，天之體也。

translations.literal: Geng, metal also, shen you all metal also, heaven's body also.
translations.idiomatic: Geng is Metal; shen and you are both Metal—the body of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 陛下紹唐、漢之運，繼黃帝之後，三世變道，應天之統，正金之德，斯又順也。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty continue Tang Han cycles, inherit Yellow Emperor after, three generations change way, respond heaven lineage, correct metal virtue, this again accord."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty continues the cycles of Tang and Han and succeeds the Yellow Emperor; through three generations the Way has shifted—responding to Heaven's lineage and correcting to the virtue of Metal—this too is accord."

sentences.zh: 詔兩制詳議。

translations.literal: Edict Two Departments detailed deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered detailed deliberation by the Two Departments.

sentences.zh: 既而獻議曰：「竊詳謝絳所述，以聖祖得瑞，宜承土德，且引漢承堯緒為火德之比，雖班彪敘漢祖之興有五，其一曰帝堯之苗裔。

translations.literal: Soon after submitted deliberation saying: "Privately detail Xie Jiang narrated, take Sacred Ancestor obtain auspice, ought inherit earth virtue, moreover cite Han inherit Yao thread as fire virtue comparison, although Ban Biao narrate Han ancestor rise have five, its one says Emperor Yao descendant branch.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward they submitted a deliberation: "We have carefully examined what Xie Jiang stated—that because the Sacred Ancestor obtained an auspicious token he ought to inherit the virtue of Earth, and that he cited Han's succession to Yao's line as a parallel to Fire—although Ban Biao, narrating the rise of Han's founder, listed five grounds, one being that he was a descendant of Emperor Yao.

sentences.zh: 及序承正統，乃越秦而繼周，非用堯之行。

translations.literal: When sequence inherit orthodox lineage, then leap Qin and inherit Zhou, not use Yao's practice.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when arranging the orthodox succession, he skipped Qin and succeeded Zhou—not applying Yao's line.

sentences.zh: 今國家或用土德，即當越唐上，承于隋，彌以非順，失其五德傳襲之序。

translations.literal: Now state perhaps use earth virtue, then ought leap Tang above, inherit at Sui, even more thereby not accord, lose its Five Phases transmit inherit sequence.
translations.idiomatic: If our state were now to adopt the virtue of Earth, it would have to leap over Tang above and inherit from Sui—still less accordant, losing the order of the Five Phases' transmission.

sentences.zh: 又據董行父請越五代紹唐為金德，若其度越累世，上承百代之統，則晉、漢洎周，鹹帝中夏，太祖實受終於周室而陟於元後，豈可弗遵傳繼之序，續於遐邈之統？

translations.literal: Also according Dong Xingfu request leap Five Dynasties continue Tang as metal virtue, if its pass over accumulated generations, above inherit hundred generations lineage, then Jin Han and Zhou, all emperors Central Plains, Taizu truly receive end at Zhou house and ascend at primary successor, how can not follow transmit inherit sequence, continue at far distant lineage?
translations.idiomatic: Again, according to Dong Xingfu's request to skip the Five Dynasties and renew Tang as Metal—if one were to pass over accumulated generations and inherit the lineage of a hundred ages above, then Jin, Han, and Zhou all held emperors over the Central Plains; Taizu truly received the end from the house of Zhou and ascended as supreme sovereign—how could one fail to follow the order of transmission and continue a lineage far removed in time?

sentences.zh: 三聖臨禦六十餘載，登封告成，昭姓紀號，率循火行之運，以輝炎靈之曜。

translations.literal: Three sages face throne sixty plus years, ascend feng announce complete, manifest surname record title, all follow fire phase cycle, thereby shine flame spirit brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Three sages have ruled for sixty-odd years; the feng ascent has been announced complete, surname and reign title proclaimed—all following the cycle of the phase of Fire, to shine with the brilliance of the flame spirit.

sentences.zh: 茲事體大，非容輕議，矧雍熙中徐鉉等議之詳矣。

translations.literal: This matter body great, not permit light deliberation, moreover Yongxi within Xu Xuan others deliberated it detailed already.
translations.idiomatic: This matter is weighty and not to be debated lightly—moreover Xu Xuan and others deliberated it in full during Yongxi.

sentences.zh: 其謝絳、董行父等所請，難以施行。」

translations.idiomatic: What Xie Jiang, Dong Xingfu, and the others requested cannot readily be implemented."

translations.literal: Edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this.
